Coalition Yottrite 9.desc: Transport Lugglop and his team, alongside <cargo>, to the <destination>, where they will share with the Coalition's scientific community their findings on yottrite.

Kimek Student 1.desc: Chikee, a young Kimek, is studying to become a Heliarch. Transport him to <destination>, where he was offered a job, so that he can make a living while studying on his own.

Kimek Student 2.name: Transport Chikee
Kimek Student 2.desc: Chikee, a young Kimek, is studying to become a Heliarch. Transport him to <destination>, where he was offered an internship and hopes to be awarded with a recommendation letter.

Kimek Student 3.name: Transport Chikee
Kimek Student 3.desc: Chikee, a young Kimek, is studying to become a Heliarch. Transport him to <destination>, where he will work with some members of House Idriss to further his research project.

Kimek Student 4.name: Transport Chikee
Kimek Student 4.desc: Chikee, the young Kimek whom you've transported many times, has finally become a candidate for elevation to the rank of Heliarch. Bring him to the <destination> by <date>.

Coalition Outbreak 1.name: Transport Doctors
Coalition Outbreak 1.desc: Bring these <bunks> doctors, along with <cargo> to <destination> by <date>, where they will work to address a major viral outbreak

Coalition Outbreak 2.name: Collect Vaccines
Coalition Outbreak 2.desc: Head to <stopovers>, where Saryd researchers have been working on a vaccine for the new virus, and deliver it to <destination> by <date>.

Coalition Outbreak 3.name: Distribute Vaccines
Coalition Outbreak 3.desc: Accompanied by the three volunteer ships, head to the designated Kimek worlds, delivering vaccines to deal with the current viral outbreak, then return to <destination> by <date>.

Kimek Gift.name: Not One Minute Late
Kimek Gift.desc: A Kimek researcher from <origin> forgot the birthday of her Saryd friend, who lives on <destination>. Since you have a jump drive and can make it there in time, she asked you to deliver the present by <date>.

Saryd Students 1.name: Acquire Arach Rum
Saryd Students 1.desc: Some Saryd students on <origin> have offered to pay you for bringing them a shipment of traditional Arach rum, currently only sold on <destination>. To make it in time, the rum must be bought by <date>.

Saryd Students 2.name: Deliver Arach Rum
Saryd Students 2.desc: Now that you've bought the two tons of Arach rum, deliver it to the Saryd students on <destination> by <date>.

Saryd Census 1.name: Saryd Census
Saryd Census 1.desc: Transport these <bunks> Saryd census workers to <destination>, where they will collect data on the population growth there.
Saryd Census 1.src: attributes saryd; not planet; not planet

Saryd Census 2.name: Saryd Census
Saryd Census 2.desc: Transport these <bunks> Saryd census workers to <destination>, where they will collect data on the population growth there.

Saryd Couple 1.name: Acquiring Funds
Saryd Couple 1.desc: Inturi and Aunaris, a young Saryd couple, need to make enough money to buy their dream home. Transport Aunaris to <destination>, where she was offered a job in the university there.

Saryd Couple 2.name: Home Sweet Plot Of Land
Saryd Couple 2.desc: The Saryd couple Inturi and Aunaris have finally amassed enough money to buy a plot of land on <destination>, where they will begin building their very own home. Bring both of them there so that they can settle the purchase.

Saryd Couple 3.name: Reversed House Spider
Saryd Couple 3.desc: Take Inturi to <destination>, where he will purchase a small Arach ship that he and Aunaris will repurpose into a home.

Saryd Couple 4.name: Test Drive, Final Drive
Saryd Couple 4.desc: Escort Inturi's ship, which will be repurposed into a home for him and Aunaris, to <destination>.

Longcow Antibiotics 1.name: Longcow Antibiotics
Longcow Antibiotics 1.desc: Arach ranchers have asked you to pick up <cargo> on <stopovers>, then deliver them to <destination>.

Longcow Antibiotics 2.name: Longcow Antibiotics
Longcow Antibiotics 2.desc: Deliver the remaining <cargo> to <destination>, where some Arachi also work as longcow ranchers.

Arachi Orphans.name: Arach Orphans
Arachi Orphans.desc: Bring these 4 Arach orphans, their caretaker, and their <cargo> to <destination>, where they will join a foster home.

Arachi Cartoonist 1.name: A New Design
Arachi Cartoonist 1.desc: The Arach cartoonist Drugub is currently struggling to find inspiration for new spaceship designs in his comics. Head to <destination> and find something you can bring back to show him the ship models produced there.

Arachi Cartoonist 2.name: A New Design
Arachi Cartoonist 2.desc: Return to Drugub on <destination>, and give him the flyer with pictures and some details of Betelgeuse's ship models.

Coalition: Alpha Encounter.name: Coalition: Alpha Encounter
Coalition: Alpha Encounter.src: government Coalition; not attributes; not planet

Saryd University Lecture.name: Transport Saryd Scientist
Saryd University Lecture.desc: Starlit University on <planet> is hosting a seminar on xenology. Transport a guest speaker there by <date>. Payment is <payment>.

Coalition: Pilgrimage 1.name: Shrine of the World Shaper
Coalition: Pilgrimage 1.desc: Bring Vellorae to <destination>, where she will begin her mourning pilgrimage for her late husband.

Coalition: Pilgrimage 2.name: Caretaker's Blessing
Coalition: Pilgrimage 2.desc: Bring Vellorae to <destination> so that she may continue her mourning pilgrimage for her late husband.

Coalition: Pilgrimage 3.name: Visit the Witch of Dusk
Coalition: Pilgrimage 3.desc: Bring Vellorae to <destination> so that she may continue her mourning pilgrimage for her late husband.

Coalition: Pilgrimage 4.name: Master Hunter's Path
Coalition: Pilgrimage 4.desc: Bring Vellorae to <destination> so that she may continue her mourning pilgrimage for her late husband.

Coalition: Pilgrimage 5.name: Woodland Thing
Coalition: Pilgrimage 5.desc: Bring Vellorae to <destination>, where she will finish her mourning pilgrimage.

Coalition: Pilgrimage 6.name: Pilgrimage's End
Coalition: Pilgrimage 6.desc: Bring Vellorae back to her home on <destination>.

Coalition: Council of Ahr.name: Council of Ahr
Coalition: Council of Ahr.desc: Bring the representatives of houses Ablomab, Bebliss, and Chamgar to <destination> by <date>, so that they may participate in the Council of Ahr.

Coalition: Council of Ahr: Drama.name: Coalition: Council of Ahr: Drama
prereq: Coalition: Council of Ahr: Bebliss: active
Coalition: Council of Ahr: Bebliss: done
Coalition: Council of Ahr: Chamgar: active
Coalition: Council of Ahr: Chamgar: done

Coalition: Council of Ahr: On Complete.id: Coalition: Council of Ahr: On Complete
Coalition: Council of Ahr: On Complete.name: Coalition: Council of Ahr: On Complete

Coalition: Submarines 1.name: Underwater Delivery
Coalition: Submarines 1.desc: Bring Apri'ie to <destination>, where five new deep-sea submarines are waiting to be brought to Second Cerulean.

Coalition: Submarines 2.name: Pressurized Stress Test
Coalition: Submarines 2.desc: Bring Apri'ie and the <cargo> to <destination>, where the submarines will be subjected to some final high-pressure stress tests.

Coalition: Submarines 3.name: Tectonic Stress Test
Coalition: Submarines 3.desc: Bring Apri'ie and the <cargo> to <destination>, where the submarines will be subjected to more stress tests to assess their repair functions.

Coalition: Submarines 4.name: Deliver the Submarines
Coalition: Submarines 4.desc: Head to <destination> with Apri'ie and the <cargo>, where the Pale Waters research center will use the new subs to conduct deep-sea expeditions.

Coalition: Expeditions Past 1.name: Scouting Permit
Coalition: Expeditions Past 1.desc: Transport Sedlitaris, a Heliarch Tribune, to the <destination>, where she will petition the Heliarch council to allow her to go on a scouting expedition out of the Coalition. Payment is <payment>.

Coalition: Expeditions Past 2.name: Relay Pylon
Coalition: Expeditions Past 2.desc: Bring Sedlitaris and some representatives of the Heliarch council to <destination>, where members of House Idriss will provide her with a relay pylon to search for signs of her ancestor's expedition.

Coalition: Expeditions Past 3.name: Dusted Dead Drop
Coalition: Expeditions Past 3.desc: Head to <destination>, where Sedlitaris wishes to check an ancient Saryd vault for the route and logs of her ancestor's expedition.

Coalition: Expeditions Past 4.name: Report: Distant Home
Coalition: Expeditions Past 4.desc: Take Sedlitaris to <destination>, the first stop of the expeditionary fleet other than the vault, so that she can begin piecing together what happened.

Coalition: Expeditions Past 5.name: Report: Ancient Light
Coalition: Expeditions Past 5.desc: Take Sedlitaris to <destination>, the next stop of the expeditionary fleet, where her ancestor wished to look into remnants of some alien ruins.

Coalition: Expeditions Past 6.name: Report: Summit
Coalition: Expeditions Past 6.desc: Take Sedlitaris to <destination>, the furthest point north on the pylon's records and next stop of the expeditionary fleet.

Coalition: Expeditions Past 7.name: Curious Red Cloud
Coalition: Expeditions Past 7.desc: Look for the system near Algieba where Mimodum, the expedition's leader, jumped to investigate the cosmological phenomenon in the system.

Coalition: Expeditions Past 8.name: Lost Checkpoint
Coalition: Expeditions Past 8.desc: Travel to the marked systems so that Sedlitaris may look for a signal frequency of the expedition.

Coalition: Expeditions Past 9.name: Escape Route
Coalition: Expeditions Past 9.desc: Explore the systems southwest of <system>, on possible routes to the Ablub system, so that Sedlitaris may look for a signal frequency of the expedition.

Coalition: Expeditions Past 10.name: Expeditions Past
Coalition: Expeditions Past 10.desc: Head back to the <destination>, where Sedlitaris will report her findings to the Heliarch council.

Coalition: Long Lost Property 1.name: Long Lost Property
Coalition: Long Lost Property 1.desc: Head to the <system> system to recover House Idriss' satellite, or try to learn what happened to it, if it isn't there.

Coalition: Long Lost Property 2.name: Lost and Found
Coalition: Long Lost Property 2.desc: Head to <planet>, base of the pirate who scavenged House Idriss' probe, and try to get it back from him.

Coalition: Long Lost Property 3.name: Reclaim the Probe
Coalition: Long Lost Property 3.desc: Search around pirate systems outside the South, and find the fleet that stole the probe. When you find it, bring it back to <destination>.

Coalition: Long Lost Property 4.name: Comparing Binaries
Coalition: Long Lost Property 4.desc: Head to <waypoints> to gather data on the binary stars, so that House Idriss may compare it with their probe's own predictions.

Coalition: Struggling Author - Human Med.name: Get Kachachee Cultural Information
Coalition: Struggling Author - Human Med.desc: A group of Coalition citizens have asked you for information on the human race. You can find that information on <stopovers>.

Coalition: Struggling Author - Book Disc.name: Look for Anna Fangvin
Coalition: Struggling Author - Book Disc.desc: Get in contact with Anna Fangvin, an author that the Coalition book club has shown interest in.

Coalition: Struggling Author 1.name: Take Anna to Coalition Space
Coalition: Struggling Author 1.desc: Take Anna Fangvin to <destination>, where she might find success as an author after having struggled on <origin> for so long.
prereq: Coalition: Struggling Author - Book Discovered: done

Coalition: Book Discovered 2.name: Beyond the Hyperdrive for Kachachee
Coalition: Book Discovered 2.desc: Now that you have a copy of Anna Fangvin's Beyond the Hyperdrive, give it to Kachachee and their group on <destination>.

Coalition: Struggling Author 2.name: Help Anna register with the Heliarchy
Coalition: Struggling Author 2.desc: Take Anna Fangvin to the <destination> so she can register with the Heliarchs.

Coalition: Struggling Author 3.name: Back to <planet>
Coalition: Struggling Author 3.desc: Now that Anna Fangvin has completed the registration process, take her and the Heliarch agent to get a translation device on <destination>.

Coalition: Struggling Author 4.name: Kimek Publishing Company
Coalition: Struggling Author 4.desc: Anna Fangvin found a Kimek publishing company who is willing to get her book published. Bring her to <destination>.

Coalition: Beyond the Hyperdrive Fail Bo.id: Coalition: Beyond the Hyperdrive Fail Book Discovered 2
Coalition: Beyond the Hyperdrive Fail Bo.name: Coalition: Beyond the Hyperdrive Fail Book Discovered 2

Coalition: Struggling Author 5A.name: Visit Anna
Coalition: Struggling Author 5A.desc: Visit the author Anna Fangvin on <destination>.

Coalition: Struggling Author 5B.name: Visit Anna
Coalition: Struggling Author 5B.desc: Visit the author Anna Fangvin on <destination>.

Heliarch Investigation 2.name: Heliarch Investigation
Heliarch Investigation 2.desc: Take the Heliarch agents to the marked planets so that they can investigate signs of criminal activity.

Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Porti.name: Investigate <planet>
Heliarch Investigation 2 - Mebla's Porti.desc: Transport the Heliarch trio to <destination> so that they can investigate signs of criminal activity.

Heliarch Investigation 2 - Stronghold of.name: Investigate <planet>
Heliarch Investigation 2 - Stronghold of.desc: Transport the Heliarch trio to <destination> so that they can investigate signs of criminal activity.

Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand.name: Investigate <planet>
Heliarch Investigation 2 - Shifting Sand.desc: Transport the Heliarch trio to <destination> so that they can investigate signs of criminal activity.

Heliarch Investigation 2 - Fourth Shadow.name: Investigate <planet>
Heliarch Investigation 2 - Fourth Shadow.desc: Transport the Heliarch trio to <destination> so that they can investigate signs of criminal activity.

Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White.name: Investigate <planet>
Heliarch Investigation 2 - Into White.desc: Transport the Heliarch trio to <destination> so that they can investigate signs of criminal activity.

Heliarch Investigation 2 - Remote Blue.name: Investigate <planet>
Heliarch Investigation 2 - Remote Blue.desc: Transport the Heliarch trio to investigate the isolated <planet>.

Heliarch Recon 1.name: Heliarch Reconnaissance
Heliarch Recon 1.desc: Fly to all the Quarg planets and stations the Heliarch asked, land on them, let your modified ship sensors scan their surroundings, and then head back to the <destination>.

Heliarch Recon 2-A.name: Scanning Preparations
Heliarch Recon 2-A.desc: Install an Outfit Scanner, then land on <destination>, where the Heliarchs will modify it to be able to scan Quarg ships the way they need it.

Heliarch Recon 2-B.name: Silent Scan
Heliarch Recon 2-B.desc: Now that the Heliarchs have altered your Outfit Scanner, head to <waypoints> and scan some Quarg ships there, then report back to <destination>.

Heliarch Recon 3-A.name: Preparations for Scanning
Heliarch Recon 3-A.desc: Head to <destination>, where the Heliarchs will discuss the next recon task they have for you.

Heliarch Recon 3-B.name: Not So Silent Scan
Heliarch Recon 3-B.desc: Now that your ship is equipped with a Heliarch Scanning Module, head to the <waypoints> system and scan the Quarg Wardragon there.

Heliarch Recon 3-C.name: Not So Silent Scan
Heliarch Recon 3-C.desc: Now that your ship is equipped with a Heliarch Scanning Module, head to the <waypoints> system and scan the Quarg Wardragon there.

Heliarch Expedition 1.name: Extraterritorial Reconnaissance
Heliarch Expedition 1.desc: Head through the wormhole in Deneb, land on the planet there, and enter the system with the broken ringworld to get data for the Heliarchy.

Heliarch Expedition 2.name: Contacted
Heliarch Expedition 2.desc: Head to <destination> where the Heliarchs will tell you about their future plans for investigating the broken Quarg ringworld.

Heliarch Expedition 3.name: Extraterritorial Venture
Heliarch Expedition 3.desc: Escort a Heliarch ship to <destination> to pick up supplies, then guide them through human space and through the wormhole in Deneb so that they can further investigate the broken ringworld.

Heliarch Expedition 4.name: Extraterritorial Venture
Heliarch Expedition 4.desc: Escort a Heliarch ship through human space and into the wormhole in Deneb, so that they can further investigate the broken ringworld.

Heliarch Expedition 5.name: Meet With Aulori
Heliarch Expedition 5.desc: Head to <destination>, where Consul Aulori wishes to speak with you about the Heliarch's findings on the destroyed ringworld.

Heliarch Containment 1.name: Transport Heliarch Soldiers
Heliarch Containment 1.desc: Bring these <bunks> Heliarch soldiers, along with <cargo>, to <destination> by <date> so they can combat a terrorist group.

Heliarch Containment 2.name: Pick Up Injured Soldiers
Heliarch Containment 2.desc: Land on <stopovers>, to pick up the <bunks> Heliarch soldiers in need of medical attention, and transport them to <destination> by <date>.

Heliarch Containment 3.name: Informational Medicine
Heliarch Containment 3.desc: While picking up <cargo> from <planet stopovers>, let loose the spy bots the Heliarchs gave you to act as surveillance for the planet.

Heliarch Containment 4-A.name: Undercover Transports
Heliarch Containment 4-A.desc: Escort three Kimek Spires full of Heliarch agents to <destination>, where they hope the use of civilian ships will give them the element of surprise.

Heliarch Containment 4-B.name: Meet with Plortub
Heliarch Containment 4-B.desc: Collect your payment for escorting the Heliarch transports.

Heliarch Containment 5.name: Stop The Fleeing Ships
Heliarch Containment 5.desc: Defeat the criminal ships that are attempting to flee. You must disable and board their ships in order to help the Heliarchs find the source of their weapons.

Heliarch Drills 1.name: Refueling Drill
Heliarch Drills 1.desc: Escort the two Heliarch Judicators to <destination>, as part of a drill testing the Coalition's refueling capabilities in emergency situations.

Heliarch Drills 2-A.name: Pursuit Drill
Heliarch Drills 2-A.desc: Land on <planet> while avoiding the Heliarch Hunters.

Heliarch Drills 2-B.name: Pursuit Drill
Heliarch Drills 2-B.desc: Land on <planet> while avoiding the Heliarch Hunters.

Heliarch Drills 2-C.name: Pursuit Drill
Heliarch Drills 2-C.desc: Land on <planet> while avoiding the Heliarch Hunters.

Heliarch Drills 3.name: Combat Drill
Heliarch Drills 3.desc: Head to the <waypoints> system to fight the <npc>, and report back to <planet> when you succeed. You must only disable the ship. Destroying or capturing it would deem you an enemy of the Heliarchs.

Heliarch License 1.name: Meet With The Consuls
Heliarch License 1.desc: Head to the <destination>, where the Heliarch consuls will make you a Heliarch agent.

Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1.name: Charity Delivery
Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 1.desc: Deliver a care package of <cargo> to <destination>, as part of a charity initiative.

Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2.name: Charity Delivery
Lunarium: Smuggling: Charity 2.desc: Bring <cargo> and <bunks> doctors to <destination>, to aid the poor Kimek on the planet who are suffering through harsh winter conditions.

Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades.name: Grenade Smuggling
Lunarium: Smuggling: Grenades.desc: Bring 100 Fragmentation Grenades from human space to <destination>.

Lunarium: Smuggling: AM.name: Anti-Missile Smuggling
Lunarium: Smuggling: AM.desc: Bring three Heavy Anti-Missile Turrets to <destination>.

Lunarium: Smuggling: Torpedoes.name: Torpedo Smuggling
Lunarium: Smuggling: Torpedoes.desc: Bring two Torpedo and two Typhoon Launchers to <destination>, along with the maximum ammunition each can carry.
Lunarium: Smuggling: Torpedoes.src: attributes kimek; not planet; not planet

Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat.name: Heated Smuggling
Lunarium: Smuggling: Heat.desc: Deliver two Plasma Turrets and ten Flamethrowers to <destination>.

Lunarium: Smuggling: Reactors.name: Reactor Smuggling
Lunarium: Smuggling: Reactors.desc: Bring an Armageddon Core, a Fusion Reactor, and a Breeder Reactor to <destination>. To avoid the risk of larger Heliarch patrols you must deliver them before the fifth day of any month.

House Bebliss 1-A.name: Meet with House Bebliss
House Bebliss 1-A.desc: Head to <destination>, where members of House Bebliss wish to discuss a job offer.

House Bebliss 1-B.name: Meet with House Bebliss
House Bebliss 1-B.desc: Head to <destination>, where representatives from an Arach House that supports the Lunarium wish to discuss a job offer.

House Bebliss 2-FW.name: Find Freya
House Bebliss 2-FW.desc: Go to <destination> and look for Freya to see if she is willing to let the members of House Bebliss study the Pug artifacts with her.

House Bebliss 3-FW.name: Tell the Free Worlds about the Coalition
House Bebliss 3-FW.desc: Go to <destination> with Freya and tell JJ all you've learned about the Coalition.

House Bebliss 4-FW.name: An Answer to House Bebliss
House Bebliss 4-FW.desc: Head back to <destination> to tell House Bebliss that Freya has agreed with their proposal.

House Bebliss 5-FW.name: Jumping Spiders
House Bebliss 5-FW.desc: Acquire a spare Jump Drive and bring it to <destination>, where the House Bebliss representatives will have it installed in one of their ships.

House Bebliss 6-FW.name: Escort House Bebliss
House Bebliss 6-FW.desc: Escort the ship with House Bebliss' representatives to <destination>, where they intend to join Freya in her studies on hyperspace links.

House Bebliss 7-FW.name: The House Always Wins
House Bebliss 7-FW.desc: Head to <destination>, where the members of House Bebliss will return the jump drive you provided them, and give you your payment for assisting them.

Lunarium: Evacuation 1.name: Pick Up Students
Lunarium: Evacuation 1.desc: Head to <destination> to pick up <bunks> students and teachers by <date>, and bring them back to their home planet of Second Viridian.

Lunarium: Evacuation 2.name: Transport The Students
Lunarium: Evacuation 2.desc: Now that you've picked up the <bunks> students and teachers, bring them to their home planet of <destination>.

Lunarium: Evacuation 3.name: Pick Up Desert Ranchers
Lunarium: Evacuation 3.desc: Head to <destination> to pick up the <bunks> ranchers by <date> and bring them back to their world, Shifting Sand.

Lunarium: Evacuation 4.name: Transport The Ranchers
Lunarium: Evacuation 4.desc: Bring the <bunks> ranchers to their world, <destination>.

Lunarium: Evacuation 5.name: Pick Up Immigrants
Lunarium: Evacuation 5.desc: Head to <destination> by <date> to pick up <bunks> immigrants, who are seeking to start a new life on Ablub's Invention.

Lunarium: Evacuation 6.name: Transport The Immigrants
Lunarium: Evacuation 6.desc: Bring the <bunks> immigrants to their new homes on <destination>.

Lunarium: Propaganda 1.name: Promoting Culture
Lunarium: Propaganda 1.desc: Bring Tummug to <destination>, where he'll meet with others to spread a set of promotional posters around the planet.

Lunarium: Propaganda 2.name: Promoting Culture
Lunarium: Propaganda 2.desc: Bring Tummug and his colleagues to <destination>, where they'll spread around some sets of banners around the planet.

Lunarium: Propaganda 3.name: Promoting Culture
Lunarium: Propaganda 3.desc: Bring Tummug and his Arachi colleagues to <destination>, with their <cargo>.

Lunarium: Propaganda 4.name: Promoting Culture
Lunarium: Propaganda 4.desc: Bring Tummug, his colleagues, and their <cargo> to <destination>.

Lunarium: Combat Training 1.name: Bootcamp
Lunarium: Combat Training 1.desc: Bring <bunks> Lunarium members, along with their <cargo> to <destination>, where they will purchase some ships and use them to fight pirates to train their combat tactics.

Lunarium: Combat Training 2.name: Combat Test
Lunarium: Combat Training 2.desc: Escort Pyakri's fleet to <waypoints>, and help them fight a pirate fleet there to get started with their training. Make sure all of the Lunarium ships survive. Return to <origin> once you're finished.

Lunarium: Combat Training 3.name: Pick Up Pyakri
Lunarium: Combat Training 3.desc: Pyakri and the other 53 Lunarium members are done with their training in human space. Head to <planet>, where they are waiting to be picked up and brought back to the Coalition.

Lunarium: Combat Training 4.name: Homecoming
Lunarium: Combat Training 4.desc: Bring the <bunks> Lunarium members back to the Coalition, to <destination>.

Lunarium: Questions.name: Lunarium Meeting
Lunarium: Questions.desc: Now that you've further helped the Lunarium, head to <destination>, where you were invited to meet with their leaders, who have a special task in mind for you.

Lunarium: Quarg Interview.name: The Interview
Lunarium: Quarg Interview.desc: Travel to <destination> with Oobat, an Arach diplomat from the Lunarium, to try and speak with the Quarg about their thoughts on the current Coalition.

Lunarium: Join.name: Report Back
Lunarium: Join.desc: Now that you and Oobat have interviewed the Quarg, head back to <destination> to inform the Lunarium leaders of how it went.

Return to Giaru Gegno.name: Return to Giaru Gegno
Return to Giaru Gegno.desc: The Quarg known as Adrauni has summoned you back to <destination>.

Gegno Anticipation.name: Summons from the Gegno
Gegno Anticipation.desc: Present yourself to the Gegno on <destination> within the next 8 days, where you will find out if you have any future with them.

Gegno Intervention.name: Summons from the Gegno
Gegno Intervention.desc: Present yourself to the Gegno on <destination> within the next 8 days, where you will find out if you have any future with them.

Acquiescence.name: Transport the Vi Warrior to <destination>.
Acquiescence.desc: Head to <destination>, with the Vi warrior as your 'passenger'.

Gegno Asteroid Mining Prologue.name: Mine 5 tons of iron
Gegno Asteroid Mining Prologue.desc: Mine and return 5 tons of iron to <destination>.

First Contact: Gegno Vi.name: <Alien> Transport
First Contact: Gegno Vi.desc: Transport the <alien> you assisted on <origin> to the location designated on the map.

Visit Quarg in Gegno Space.name: Travel to <designated system>
Visit Quarg in Gegno Space.desc: Travel to the <designated system> as instructed.

prereq: Visit Quarg in Gegno Space: offered

Nosy Scin.name: Nosy Scin
prereq: Visit Quarg in Gegno Space: offered

Suspicious Scin.name: Strange Device
Suspicious Scin.desc: A strange Gegno device suddenly appeared on your ship, displaying coordinates to a planet within Gegno space. Visiting the planet might lead to some answers, or perhaps something else.

Gegno Exploration Nudge.name: Find ways to interact with the Gegno
Gegno Exploration Nudge.desc: Although the Gegno seem disinterested in you as a whole, there might be other chances to encounter them in their space to learn more about them.

Gegno Asteroid Mining - Aluminum.name: Gather 10 tons of aluminum
Gegno Asteroid Mining - Aluminum.desc: Mine and collect 10 tons of aluminum, then bring the minerals back to the Gegno at <origin>.

Gegno Asteroid Mining - Copper.name: Gather 10 tons of copper
Gegno Asteroid Mining - Copper.desc: Mine and collect 10 tons of copper, then bring the minerals back to the Gegno at <origin>.

Gegno Asteroid Mining - Iron.name: Gather 10 tons of iron
Gegno Asteroid Mining - Iron.desc: Mine and collect 10 tons of iron, then bring the minerals back to the Gegno at <origin>.

Gegno Asteroid Mining - Lead.name: Gather 10 tons of lead
Gegno Asteroid Mining - Lead.desc: Mine and collect 10 tons of lead, then bring the minerals back to the Gegno at <origin>.

Gegno Asteroid Mining - Silicon.name: Gather 10 tons of silicon
Gegno Asteroid Mining - Silicon.desc: Mine and collect 10 tons of silicon, then bring the minerals back to the Gegno at <origin>.

Gegno Asteroid Mining - Titanium.name: Gather 10 tons of titanium
Gegno Asteroid Mining - Titanium.desc: Mine and collect 10 tons of titanium, then bring the minerals back to the Gegno at <origin>.

Deep: Remnant: Keystone Research.desc: Meet up with Ivan on <destination> to learn about his research on the quantum keystones you brought him.

Deep: Remnant 1.name: Exploring the Unknown
Deep: Remnant 1.desc: Explore the region of space beyond the Terminus wormhole. Return to <destination> after exploring everything you can reach.

Deep: Remnant 2.name: Analyze Wormholes
Deep: Remnant 2.desc: Ivan and his team are interested in studying the wormholes beyond the one in Terminus. Return to the strange region of space and travel through the wormholes that create a loop while carrying the scanning equipment.

Deep: Remnant 3: Secret.name: Analyze Alien Creatures
Deep: Remnant 3: Secret.desc: Scan the "outfits" of the alien creatures in Nenia, then return to the scientists on <destination> with the detailed scanner logs.

Deep: Remnant 3: Revealed.name: Analyze Remnant Ships
Deep: Remnant 3: Revealed.desc: Scan the outfits of the Remnant ships in Arculus, then return to the scientists on <destination> with the detailed scanner logs.

Deep: Remnant: Continue Research.name: Travel to <planet>

Deep: Remnant: Engines.name: Fetching Engines

Deep: Remnant: Generators.name: Fetching a Generator

FW Recon 2.name: Free Worlds Reconnaissance
FW Recon 2.desc: Scan any ships in the <waypoints> system that are equipped like the combat-ready Cruiser you scanned previously, then return to <destination>.

FW Recon 3.name: Free Worlds Reconnaissance
FW Recon 3.desc: Land on <destination> and secretly collect information on the developing Navy base there.

FW Recon 3B.name: Free Worlds Reconnaissance
FW Recon 3B.desc: Return to <destination> with information on the Navy base on <origin>.

FW Escort 0.name: Free Worlds Escort
FW Escort 0.desc: Head to <destination> to meet up with a convoy of Free Worlds freighters.

FW Escort 1.name: Free Worlds Escort
FW Escort 1.desc: Escort a Free Worlds supply convoy safely to <destination>.

FW Escort 1B.name: Free Worlds Escort
FW Escort 1B.desc: Escort the supply convoy safely to <destination> back in Free Worlds territory.

FW Escort 2.name: Free Worlds Escort
FW Escort 2.desc: Escort a Free Worlds supply convoy safely to <destination>.

FW Escort 2B.name: Free Worlds Escort
FW Escort 2B.desc: Escort a Free Worlds supply convoy safely to <destination>.

FW Escort 3.desc: Repair the <npc>, which is stranded in the <waypoints> system, and escort it safely back to <destination>.

FW Escort Second Chance.name: Second Chance
FW Escort Second Chance.desc: Return to <destination> to meet up with Tomek Voigt and see if he will forgive you for failing the escort mission he gave you.

FW Bounty 1.name: Free Worlds Bounty Hunting
FW Bounty 1.desc: Hunt down and destroy the "Rat Pack," a gang of pirate ships led by a flagship named "Cluny" who have been harassing merchants in Free Worlds space. They were last seen just northeast of Kornephoros. After defeating them, return to <destination>.

FW Bounty 2.name: Free Worlds Bounty Hunting
FW Bounty 2.desc: A Free Worlds militia officer from <destination> asked you to hunt down the <npc>, a pirate ship pillaging ships headed to Tarazed. The militia officer suggested trying to attack the ship from a distance.

FW Bounty 3.name: Free Worlds Bounty Hunting
FW Bounty 3.desc: A Free Worlds militia officer from <destination> asked you to hunt down the <npc>, a powerful pirate ship last seen in the Shaula system.

FW Katya 1.name: Assist the Free Worlds
FW Katya 1.desc: Stop by <destination>, pick up two passengers and some cargo, and distract the Republic from a more important cargo exchange going on simultaneously.

FW Katya 1B.name: Assist the Free Worlds
FW Katya 1B.desc: Bring some cargo (harmless but intended to look suspicious) and two tourists to <destination>.

FW Katya Alt 2.name: Transport Mr. Eyes
FW Katya Alt 2.desc: Katya Reynolds asked you to travel to <destination>, where her friend Mr. Eyes is waiting for you.

FW Katya 2.name: Transport Mr. Eyes
FW Katya 2.desc: Katya Reynolds asked you to travel to <destination>, where her friend Mr. Eyes is waiting for you.

FW Katya 2B.name: Transport Mr. Eyes
FW Katya 2B.desc: Transport Mr. Eyes to <destination>, where the recent terrorist attack took place.

FW Katya 2C.name: Transport Mr. Eyes
FW Katya 2C.desc: Bring Mr. Eyes to <destination>, where you will meet up with Katya (and hopefully get paid).

FW Katya 3.name: Drone Hunting
FW Katya 3.desc: Disable a surveillance drone (ideally when no Cruisers are watching), board it, "salvage" its surveillance equipment, and return to <destination>. (Until you leave the system where you disabled the drone, other Republic ships may attack you.)

FW Katya 4.name: Katya and Mr. Eyes
FW Katya 4.desc: Stop on <destination> and check the planet for signs of nuclear testing.

FW Katya 5.name: Information Gathering
FW Katya 5.desc: Bring Katya and Mr. Eyes to <destination>, where some monks may be able to help you negotiate with the pirates for information.

FW Katya 5B.name: Information Gathering
FW Katya 5B.desc: Travel to <planet> with Brother Greg and see if he can get any information from the pirates there. (Hail the planet to have him negotiate landing clearance.)

FW Katya 5C.name: Information Gathering
FW Katya 5C.desc: Return to <planet> with Katya and Brother Greg.

FW Katya 7.name: The Hunt Continues
FW Katya 7.desc: Take Katya and Eyes to <destination> to check for signs of underwater testing.

FW Katya 7B.name: The Hunt Continues
FW Katya 7B.desc: Take Katya and Eyes to the mining moon <planet>.

FW Katya 7C.name: Bring Eyes to <planet>
FW Katya 7C.desc: While Katya is undercover on <origin>, bring Mr. Eyes to <destination> to report to the Free Worlds.

FW Commitment.name: Join the Free Worlds
FW Commitment.desc: If you want to join the Free Worlds, report to their headquarters on <destination>.

Rescue Katya 1.name: Rescue Katya
Rescue Katya 1.desc: Rescue Katya from <planet>, before the Navy discovers her, and bring her safely to Longjump.

Rescue Katya 2.name: Rescue Katya
Rescue Katya 2.desc: Return to <planet> and report to the Free Worlds Council that you were unable to locate Katya.

Defend Sabik.name: Defend Sabik
Defend Sabik.desc: Help to repulse a Navy attack on Sabik, then land on Longjump to debrief.

Liberate Kornephoros.name: Liberate Kornephoros
Liberate Kornephoros.desc: Travel with the Free Worlds militia to the <system> system and drive off the Navy fleet that is occupying the system.

FW Prisoner Parole.name: Prisoner Parole
FW Prisoner Parole.desc: Escort a fleet of transports carrying prisoners of war to <planet>. The temporary ceasefire will end on <date>.

FW Prisoner Parole 2.name: Prisoner Parole
FW Prisoner Parole 2.desc: Return to Deep before the cease-fire ends.

FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1.name: Syndicate Diplomacy
FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1.desc: Transport Alondo Gruyere to the Syndicate headquarters on <planet>.

FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B.name: Tarazed Diplomacy
FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1B.desc: Transport Alondo Gruyere to <planet> to negotiate with Tarazed Corporation.

FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1C.name: Poisonwood Diplomacy
FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1C.desc: Travel to <planet> with Alondo Gruyere, to make one final diplomatic visit.

FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D.name: Return to <planet>
FW Syndicate Diplomacy 1D.desc: Return to <planet> with Alondo, to report on the outcome of your diplomatic mission.

FW Hope Recon 1.name: Early Warning Systems
FW Hope Recon 1.desc: Land on the abandoned planet <destination> and place sensors there to monitor Navy fleet activity in the system.

FW Hope Recon 1D.name: Destroy Sensors
FW Hope Recon 1D.desc: Travel back to <destination> and destroy any Republic sensors you find there.

FW Plasma Testing 1.name: Weapons Testing
FW Plasma Testing 1.desc: Report to <destination> to assist in some experimental weapons testing.

FW Plasma Testing 1B.name: Weapons Testing
FW Plasma Testing 1B.desc: As a test for the new Plasma Turret, assist the Walloping Window-Blind in destroying the Red Nile, a pirate ship that is probably in the <marks> system. Then return to <planet>.

FW Supply Convoy 1.name: Escort Supply Convoy
FW Supply Convoy 1.desc: Escort this convoy carrying equipment from Kraz Cybernetics to the militia base on <destination>.

FW Pirates 1.name: Pirate Reconnaissance
FW Pirates 1.desc: Scout out four pirate systems on the southern fringe of human space, then report back to Tomek on <planet>.

FW Senate 1.name: Senator Huygens
FW Senate 1.desc: Meet Senator Arianna Huygens on <planet>, and transport her to the new Free Worlds Senate building on Bourne.

FW Pirates 2.name: Southern Patrol
FW Pirates 2.desc: Lead a patrol through the Free Worlds systems on the Southern Rim, driving off any pirates you encounter, then meet up with Tomek on <destination>.

FW Pirates Patch.name: Return to <planet>
FW Pirates Patch.desc: Return to <destination> to continue your work with the Free Worlds.

FW Pirates: Attack 1.name: Attack Greenrock
FW Pirates: Attack 1.desc: Disobeying the Senate's orders, head to <destination> and gather a Free Worlds fleet for an all-out attack on the pirate world of Greenrock.

FW Pirates: Attack 2.name: Attack Greenrock
FW Pirates: Attack 2.desc: Disobeying the Senate's orders, launch an all-out attack on the pirate world of <destination>, then land there.

FW Pirates: Attack 3.name: Early Warning
FW Pirates: Attack 3.desc: The early warning systems you installed on Hope have detected a heightened Navy presence. Travel to <destination> to defend against the potential Navy assault. Any punishment for the invasion of Greenrock will come later.

FW Pirates: Diplomacy 1.name: Pirate Diplomacy
FW Pirates: Diplomacy 1.desc: Following the Senate's orders, travel to <destination> and negotiate with the ruling authorities. Don't fight pirates if you don't have to, and don't let your escort be destroyed.

FW Pirates: Diplomacy 2.name: Defend Thule
FW Pirates: Diplomacy 2.desc: Destroy the pirate fleet that is attacking the spaceport on Thule. Free Worlds reinforcements ought to be on their way.

FW Pirates: Diplomacy 3.name: Return to Longjump
FW Pirates: Diplomacy 3.desc: Escort the newly repaired F.S. Terebinth back to the Free Worlds base on <destination>.

FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4.name: Early Warning
FW Pirates: Diplomacy 4.desc: The early warning systems you installed on Hope have detected a heightened Navy presence. Travel to <destination> to defend against the potential Navy assault. Any punishment for the invasion of Greenrock will come later.

FW Early Warning 1.name: Early Warning
FW Early Warning 1.desc: The Navy looks as though they're preparing for an attack. Scout the <waypoints> systems just north of Free Worlds space to determine the strength of the Navy there.

FW Early Warning 2.name: Seeking Harmony
FW Early Warning 2.desc: <planet> has become an unofficial ceasefire zone for the Navy and Free Worlds patrols in the eastern Dirt Belt. Bring JJ there to attempt to negotiate with the Navy to prevent an attack.

FW Early Warning 3.name: Harmony Lost
FW Early Warning 3.desc: The peace talks with the Navy have broken down. Another battle seems inevitable. Return to <destination> with JJ to prepare.

FW Early Warning 4.name: Preemptive Strike
FW Early Warning 4.desc: Meet the Navy ships for battle in <system>, attacking them before they can enter Free Worlds space. Once all the ships have been destroyed, land on <planet>.

FW Early Warning 5.name: Return to <planet>
FW Early Warning 5.desc: With the battle won, return to <destination> to report to Freya.

FW Senate Hearing.name: Senate Hearing
FW Senate Hearing.desc: Report to <destination> for a Senate hearing on your recent failure to obey their orders. If you do not arrive by <date>, your service will be terminated.

FW Refinery 1.name: Smuggler's Den Repairs
FW Refinery 1.desc: Travel to <planet> and pick up a shipment of equipment from the Syndicate for repairing the refinery on Smuggler's Den.

FW Refinery 1A.name: <planet> Repairs
FW Refinery 1A.desc: Bring a shipment of special refinery equipment to <destination>.

FW Diplomacy 1.name: Free Worlds Diplomacy
FW Diplomacy 1.desc: Travel to <planet> to meet up with Alondo, who will explain more.

FW Diplomacy 1B.name: Free Worlds Diplomacy
FW Diplomacy 1B.desc: Bring Alondo to <planet> to meet with Parliament. Your guarantee of safe passage will expire on <day>.

FW Diplomacy 1C.name: Free Worlds Diplomacy
FW Diplomacy 1C.desc: Bring Alondo to <planet> to meet with the senior Navy officers. Take as direct a route as possible, because your safe passage expires soon.

FW Diplomacy 1D.name: Free Worlds Diplomacy
FW Diplomacy 1D.desc: Bring Alondo back to <destination>. Take as direct a route as possible, because your safe passage expires soon.

FW Southern Recon 1.name: Reconnaissance
FW Southern Recon 1.desc: Fly through <waypoints> to get a sense of the Navy's strength in those systems, then report to <destination>.

FW Southern Recon 1B.name: Electron Beam
FW Southern Recon 1B.desc: Steal an Electron Beam from a Navy Gunboat and return it to <planet> for Freya to look at. She thought your best bet for finding lone Gunboats might be the Wei or Alnasl systems.

FW Southern Battle 1.name: Escort Battle Fleet
FW Southern Battle 1.desc: Travel to <planet> to gather a fleet of experimental new warships, and escort them back to Trinket.

FW Southern Battle 1B.name: Escort Battle Fleet
FW Southern Battle 1B.desc: Escort a fleet of experimental warships to <destination>.

FW Southern Battle 2.name: Attack Rastaban
FW Southern Battle 2.desc: Travel directly to the <system> system, so that you will arrive on <day> and join the battle against the Navy. Disable or destroy all Navy ships in the system.

FW Southern Battle 3.name: Sweep for Navy Ships
FW Southern Battle 3.desc: Travel through the systems near Rastaban and make sure that the remainder of the Navy occupation fleet is retreating. (If they are fleeing, let them flee.)

FW Southern Prisoners - Release.name: Return Navy Prisoners
FW Southern Prisoners - Release.desc: As a goodwill gesture, return the Navy prisoners to <destination> rather than imprisoning them on Clink. Your safe passage ends on <day>.

FW Southern Prisoners - Keep.name: Keep Navy Prisoners
FW Southern Prisoners - Keep.desc: Rather than releasing the Navy prisoners, deliver them to the mines on Clink, to be held until Katya is returned to you.

FW Southern Prisoners - Released.name: Report to Dancer
FW Southern Prisoners - Released.desc: Report back to Freya and Alondo on Dancer that you chose to release the prisoners.

FW Southern Prisoners - Kept.name: Report to Dancer
FW Southern Prisoners - Kept.desc: Report back to Freya and Alondo on Dancer that you chose to keep the prisoners on Clink.

FW Southern Break Ends.name: Return to <planet>
FW Southern Break Ends.desc: Travel as quickly as possible to <destination> to rejoin the main Free Worlds fleet.

FW Northern 1.name: Northern Expansion
FW Northern 1.desc: Take a fleet to <destination> (visiting <waypoints> along the way), securing those systems to allow them to defect to the Free Worlds.

FW Northern 2.name: Meet With Freya
FW Northern 2.desc: Now that the northern star systems are secured, go back to <planet> to meet with Freya and work with her to remove any surveillance equipment the Navy installed in the Wei system or elsewhere.

FW Northern 2A.name: Sweep Hope
FW Northern 2A.desc: Bring Freya to <planet> and destroy any Navy sensor emplacements that she finds there.

FW Northern 2B.name: Sweep Clark
FW Northern 2B.desc: Bring Freya to <planet> to check for any Navy surveillance stations.

FW Northern 2C.name: Sweep New Holland
FW Northern 2C.desc: Bring Freya to <planet> to check for any Navy surveillance stations.

FW Northern 2D.name: Sweep New Tibet
FW Northern 2D.desc: Bring Freya to <planet> to check for any Navy surveillance stations.

FW Northern 3.name: Freya to Zug
FW Northern 3.desc: Bring Freya to <destination> to help with ramping up Dreadnought production.

FW Northern 3B.name: Dreadnoughts to <planet>
FW Northern 3B.desc: Escort two more Dreadnoughts to <destination> to help defend the front against any Navy incursions.

FW Northern 4.name: Meet Convoy
FW Northern 4.desc: Travel to <destination> to escort a convoy of medical supplies. Watch out for Republic attacks.

FW Northern 4.1A.name: Medical Convoy
FW Northern 4.1A.desc: Escort a convoy carrying medical supplies safely to <planet>. Do not fire on the Navy Oathkeeper ship that is in orbit there.

FW Northern 4.2A.name: Medical Convoy
FW Northern 4.2A.desc: Escort a convoy carrying medical supplies safely to <planet>.

FW Alphas 1.1.name: Liberate Poisonwood
FW Alphas 1.1.desc: Destroy the pirate ships occupying the <system> system with the help of the Navy Oathkeepers, then land on the planet and let the Navy troops eliminate the Alphas.

FW Alphas 1.2.name: Liberate Poisonwood
FW Alphas 1.2.desc: Destroy any pirate ships in orbit around <planet>, then land and eliminate the Alphas and their servants who have occupied the city.

FW Alphas 1.1A.name: Danforth to <planet>
FW Alphas 1.1A.desc: Escort Admiral Danforth's ship to <destination> so that he can leave Free space without being accidentally attacked.

FW Alphas 1.2A.name: Return to the Front
FW Alphas 1.2A.desc: Travel to <destination> to bolster the defenses there.

FW Bloodsea 1.name: Alondo to <planet>
FW Bloodsea 1.desc: Bring Alondo to <planet> to try to convince the locals to join the Free Worlds.

FW Bloodsea 1.1.name: Ships from <planet>
FW Bloodsea 1.1.desc: In order to work toward a peace treaty with Bloodsea, meet up with a convoy of heavily armed merchant ships on <planet>.

FW Bloodsea 1.1A.name: Supplies from <planet>
FW Bloodsea 1.1A.desc: Stop on <planet> so that the ships you are escorting can pick up more supplies and workers, then bring them to Bloodsea to help build a new spaceport.

FW Bloodsea 1.1B.name: Supplies to <planet>
FW Bloodsea 1.1B.desc: Escort these two freighters to <destination> to help build a new spaceport. This may just be an excuse for pirates to attack you.

FW Bloodsea 1.2.name: Invasion Fleet
FW Bloodsea 1.2.desc: Rather than pursuing a diplomatic agreement, meet up with JJ on <planet> and gather a fleet to invade and subjugate Bloodsea.

FW Bloodsea 1.2A.name: Capture Bloodsea
FW Bloodsea 1.2A.desc: Take a Free Worlds fleet to invade the <system> system and eliminate any pirate resistance, then land on <planet>.

FW Dreadnoughts Ready.name: Meet Freya on <planet>
FW Dreadnoughts Ready.desc: Freya is done overseeing the initial production run of Dreadnoughts in the shipyard on Zug. Meet up with her there, to give her a ride to wherever she is assigned next.

FW Albatross 1.name: Freya to <planet>
FW Albatross 1.desc: Bring Freya to <planet> to meet up with JJ and make plans for convincing Albatross to give up piracy and join the Free Worlds.

FW Albatross 2.name: Visit Albatross
FW Albatross 2.desc: Bring JJ to Albatross to negotiate with the local leaders and perhaps convince them to join the Free Worlds and give up their support of piracy.

FW Albatross 2A.name: Hunt Ryk Bartlett
FW Albatross 2A.desc: Hunt down the pirate warlord Ryk Bartlett, who has been plundering merchant convoys in the vicinity of Zeta Aquilae. (Only his personal ship, the Dread, must be destroyed.) Then, return to Albatross.

FW Albatross 2B.name: Return to Dancer
FW Albatross 2B.desc: Return to Dancer with JJ, and meet up with Freya.

FW Rand 1.name: Occupy Zeta Aquilae
FW Rand 1.desc: Take a Free Worlds fleet to Zeta Aquilae, drive away whatever Navy ships are there, and then land on Rand, which has decided to join the Free Worlds.

FW Rand 1B.name: Regroup at Wayfarer
FW Rand 1B.desc: The Free Worlds fleet has been scattered by a Navy invasion. Regroup with the ships that fled to <destination>, and plan your next move.

FW Defend New Tibet.name: The Defector
FW Defend New Tibet.desc: Travel to New Tibet to question the Syndicate about the defector supposedly carrying vital evidence and information that they are behind the bombings.

FW Liberate Delta Sagittarii.name: Liberate Delta Sagittarii
FW Liberate Delta Sagittarii.desc: Lead a Free Worlds fleet to drive the Navy out of Delta Sagittarii. Another fleet ought to be arriving from the Rim at about the same time.

FWC Scouting 1.name: Scout Kaus Borealis
FWC Scouting 1.desc: Travel through the <waypoints> system to determine how strong the Navy presence is there, while JJ works to gather a fleet to attack it.

FWC Attack Kaus Borealis.name: Attack Kaus Borealis
FWC Attack Kaus Borealis.desc: Destroy the Navy fleet defending Kaus Borealis. The Wolf Pack will attack them first to soften them up.

FWC Cebalrai 1.name: Scout out Cebalrai
FWC Cebalrai 1.desc: Scout out the Navy presence in the <waypoints> system, then report back to Tomek on <planet>.

FWC Cebalrai 1B.name: Capture Cebalrai
FWC Cebalrai 1B.desc: Lead an attack on the Cebalrai system and drive out or destroy any Navy ships that you find there.

FWC Nuke Supply 1.name: Uranium Convoy
FWC Nuke Supply 1.desc: Travel to Oblivion to escort a freighter that is delivering uranium to a warlord on Greenrock.

FWC Nuke Supply 1B.name: Uranium Convoy
FWC Nuke Supply 1B.desc: Escort a freighter that is delivering uranium to a warlord on Greenrock.

FWC Nuke Supply 1C.name: Warhead Convoy
FWC Nuke Supply 1C.desc: Escort a freighter carrying nuclear warheads to Solace.

FWC Diplomacy 1.name: Let's Try Diplomacy
FWC Diplomacy 1.desc: Return to Tundra to meet up with Alondo and take him on another visit to Parliament. Maybe this time they will be willing to negotiate a truce.

FWC Diplomacy 1B.name: Let's Try Diplomacy
FWC Diplomacy 1B.desc: Travel to Earth with Alondo and meet with Parliament to try to negotiate terms of a truce.

FWC Diplomacy 1C.name: Return to <planet>
FWC Diplomacy 1C.desc: The peace negotiations with Parliament failed. Return to <planet> without being destroyed by the Navy.

FWC Checkmate 1.name: Defend Cebalrai
FWC Checkmate 1.desc: Destroy the Republic ships that are attacking this system, then land and decide what to do next. Free Worlds reinforcements should be on their way.

FWC Checkmate 1: Equipment.name: Upgrade Your Ship
FWC Checkmate 1: Equipment.desc: If you want, travel to <destination> to install nuclear missiles in your ship. You may also want to invest in some other upgrades. Then meet Tomek and the others in the spaceport on Tundra.

FWC Checkmate 1: Equipment 2.name: Upgrade Your Ship
FWC Checkmate 1: Equipment 2.desc: Make any further upgrades to your ship that you consider necessary. Then meet Tomek and the others in the spaceport on Tundra.

FWC Checkmate 1B.name: Attack Menkent
FWC Checkmate 1B.desc: The Wolf Pack has launched an initial attack on the Menkent system. Follow up with your fleet and finish off the Navy defenses. Katya will ride with you.

FWC Checkmate 1C.name: Capture <planet>
FWC Checkmate 1C.desc: Bring a fleet to <destination>, driving off any Republic ships in the system.

FWC Pug 1.name: Defend <planet>
FWC Pug 1.desc: <planet> is under attack by ships of an unknown type. Drive them off, and then return to the planet to figure out what to do next.

FWC Pug 1B.name: Investigate <system>
FWC Pug 1B.desc: This area of space has somehow been cut off from the rest of the galaxy. Visit <planet> to see if they, too, have been invaded by the aliens.

FWC Pug 2.name: Report to Katya
FWC Pug 2.desc: You met someone on Shiver who was able to give you more information about the aliens and their intentions. Report back to Katya with what you discovered.

FWC Pug 2B.name: Visit the Pug
FWC Pug 2B.desc: Locate the Pug homeworld, which is presumably in the <system> system, and see if you can negotiate with them.

FWC Pug 2C.name: Visit <planet>
FWC Pug 2C.desc: Visit <destination>, which was part of Free Worlds territory before the alien invasion, and see if any military equipment is still available there.

FWC Pug 2D.name: Escape Pug Space
FWC Pug 2D.desc: Disable one of the Pug ships, steal its jump drive, and use it to escape from their territory and report to the Free Worlds that an alien invasion is imminent.

FWC Pug 3.name: Talk to the Navy
FWC Pug 3.desc: Freya is on <planet>, presumably in Navy custody. Travel there and see if, given the current circumstances, the Navy is willing to talk with you.

FWC Pug 3A.name: Bring Freya to <planet>
FWC Pug 3A.desc: Freya thinks that if she can locate the equipment the Pug used to disrupt the hyperspace links, she may be able to restore them. Take her to <planet>, while Katya stays behind in the Navy's custody.

FWC Pug 3B.name: Defend <planet>
FWC Pug 3B.desc: Freya found a piece of alien technology that she believes can be used to restore the hyperspace link. Hold off the Pug for long enough for her to figure out how it works.

FWC Pug 3C.name: Return to <planet>
FWC Pug 3C.desc: Return to <planet> with Freya, carrying a "graviton reflector" that Freya thinks can be used to restore the hyperspace link.

FWC Pug 3D.name: Liberate <system>
FWC Pug 3D.desc: Travel to the <system> system with a combined fleet of Navy and Free Worlds ships, drive off the Pug, and occupy the system so that the Pug cannot return and sever the hyperspace link again.

FWC Pug 4.name: Defend <system>
FWC Pug 4.desc: Drive off the Pug fleet that is invading <system>.

FWC Pug 4A.name: Equipment from <planet>
FWC Pug 4A.desc: Travel with Freya to pick up the alien equipment that you installed on <planet> and bring it to Arabia to reopen another of the hyperspace links.

FWC Pug 4B.name: Equipment to <planet>
FWC Pug 4B.desc: Travel with Freya to <planet> to set up the alien equipment and see if you can reopen another one of the disrupted hyperspace links.

FWC Pug 4B: Quarg.name: Visit the Quarg
FWC Pug 4B: Quarg.desc: If you want, visit the Quarg to see what they can tell you about the Pug, before you continue fighting them.

FWC Pug 4C.name: Liberate <planet>
FWC Pug 4C.desc: Travel to the <system> system to assist the Navy in driving out the Pug and reestablishing a direct hyperspace link to the Ascella system.

FWC Pug 5.name: Liberate <system>
FWC Pug 5.desc: Some of the Navy ships have been outfitted with jump drives. Travel with them to the <system> system, avoiding the main Pug fleet in their home system, and reclaim control of the planet.

FWC Pug 5B.name: Travel to <planet>
FWC Pug 5B.desc: Travel with Freya to <planet>, where you can set up the "graviton reflector" to restore the hyperspace link from Sol to the Pug territory. (She thinks Mars is a better option than a heavily populated planet like Earth.)

FWC Pug 5C.name: Return to <planet>
FWC Pug 5C.desc: Return to <planet>, and join the Navy fleet in preparing for an attack on the Pug home system. A Free Worlds fleet will be attacking from the south at the same time.

FWC Pug 6.name: Defeat the Pug
FWC Pug 6.desc: Join the Navy fleet in attacking the Pug home system. Once their fleet is eliminated, land on their home world of <planet> to attempt to negotiate for peace.

FWC End.name: Talk to Parliament
FWC End.desc: Travel to Earth for another meeting with Parliament. Alondo and Katya will meet you there. (Hopefully it will go better than your last visit.)

FW Reconciliation 1.name: Pick up Ijs from <planet>
FW Reconciliation 1.desc: Bring Katya and Sawyer to <destination>, along with Raven's ship (the Eye of Horus), and pick up Ijs and his equipment for detecting atomic testing.

FW Reconciliation 1B.name: Travel to <planet>
FW Reconciliation 1B.desc: Bring Ijs, Sawyer, and Katya to <system>. Destroy any Syndicate ships that are watching you, then land on <planet>. Make sure Raven's ship arrives there as well. You may need to bribe Syndicate worlds to let you refuel.

FW Reconciliation 1C.name: Bring evidence to <planet>
FW Reconciliation 1C.desc: Travel to <planet>, without you or Raven being killed by the Syndicate, to present your evidence and Sawyer's confession to Parliament.

FW Reconciliation 2.name: Visit to the Deep
FW Reconciliation 2.desc: One of the representatives from the Deep gave you a note requesting that you visit them on <destination>. Travel there with Katya, Ijs, Sawyer, and Raven.

FW Reconciliation 2A.name: Oathkeepers on Farpoint
FW Reconciliation 2A.desc: Travel to <destination> to meet with the Navy Oathkeepers. Raven's ship will continue to travel with you.

FW Reconciliation 2B.name: Travel to Stormhold
FW Reconciliation 2B.desc: Sawyer has named several Syndicate executives who were definitely part of the plot. Travel to the lawless world of Stormhold, where you will be able to purchase information about where those executives live.

FW Reconciliation 2C.name: Return to Farpoint
FW Reconciliation 2C.desc: Return to <planet> with information about the whereabouts of certain Syndicate executives. Travel via the back route so that the Syndicate is not alerted to your presence.

FW Defend Farpoint.name: Defend Farpoint
FW Defend Farpoint.desc: Assist the Oathkeepers in defending <planet> from a pirate attack, then land back on the planet.

FW Embassy 1.name: Ambassadors from Earth
FW Embassy 1.desc: The Republic has agreed to set up an embassy to the Free Worlds. Travel to Earth to meet the ambassadors and escort them to Free space.

FW Embassy 1B.name: Ambassadors to Bourne
FW Embassy 1B.desc: Escort this luxury vessel carrying Republic ambassadors to the Free Worlds capital of <destination>.

FW Reconciliation Break.name: Katya and Ijs to <planet>
FW Reconciliation Break.desc: Bring Katya and Ijs to <destination> for a well-deserved sabbatical. Then you will be free to spend some time upgrading your ship while you wait for the Senate to select a team of ambassadors.

FW Reconciliation Break Ends.name: Return to <planet>
FW Reconciliation Break Ends.desc: Rejoin Ijs, Katya, and Alondo on <destination>.

FW Embassy 1C.name: Ambassadors to Earth
FW Embassy 1C.desc: Escort a Dreadnought carrying Free Worlds ambassadors to Earth. This Dreadnought will then take part in your combined "police action" against the Syndicate.

FW Syndicate Capture 1.name: Raid on Nimbus
FW Syndicate Capture 1.desc: Travel to <destination> along with ships from the Oathkeepers, the Deep, and the Free Worlds, to capture Alexander Soylent, a Syndicate executive. Do not allow your escorts to be destroyed.

FW Syndicate Capture 1B.name: Escape to <planet>
FW Syndicate Capture 1B.desc: You have captured the Syndicate executive Alexander Soylent. Now, bring him safely to <planet>, where he will face trial.

FW Syndicate Capture 1C.name: Return to <planet>
FW Syndicate Capture 1C.desc: The Syndicate is massing a fleet in the Sol system. Return to <planet> to rendezvous with the Free Worlds fleet in order to be ready to defend Earth if it is attacked.

FW Pug 1.name: What happened to Rand?
FW Pug 1.desc: Try to determine why communications with Rand in the Zeta Aquilae system were cut off.

FW Pug 2.name: Meet with Parliament
FW Pug 2.desc: Travel with Alondo to Earth to meet with Parliament. They are now much more willing to meet with you given how real the Syndicate threat seems.

FW Pug 2A.name: Reason with the Syndicate
FW Pug 2A.desc: Travel with Alondo to meet with the Syndicate leaders on Foundry, determine their intentions, and convince them not to completely seal themselves off from human space. Hurry, before they cut the last link.

FW Pug 2B.name: Install a Jump Drive
FW Pug 2B.desc: Travel to the Syndicate world of Hephaestus, where the Syndicate Systems personnel have been instructed to install a jump drive on your ship, so that you can investigate the systems that the Pug has cut off.

FW Pug 2C: Hyperdrive.name: Investigate the Pug
FW Pug 2C: Hyperdrive.desc: Travel to the Deneb system to investigate the Pug; if possible, make contact with them and determine what their goals and desires are.

FW Pug 2C: Scram Drive.name: Investigate the Pug
FW Pug 2C: Scram Drive.desc: Travel to the Deneb system to investigate the Pug; if possible, make contact with them and determine what their goals and desires are.

FW Pug 2C: Jump Drive.name: Investigate the Pug
FW Pug 2C: Jump Drive.desc: Travel to the Deneb system to investigate the Pug; if possible, make contact with them and determine what their goals and desires are.

FW Pug 3.name: Bring news to Earth
FW Pug 3.desc: Now that you have met with the Pug, travel to Earth and explain the situation to Parliament, and send word to the Free Worlds as well, so you can decide how to respond.

FW Pug 3: Deep.name: Visit the Deep (optional)
FW Pug 3: Deep.desc: The Pug hinted that they have helped the people of the Deep in the past. Talk to Edrick, the governor of Valhalla, to see what he knows about the Pug. (This mission is optional.)

FW Pug 3: Quarg.name: Visit the Quarg (optional)
FW Pug 3: Quarg.desc: Visit the Quarg on <planet> to see if they know anything about the Pug or are willing to help you fight them. (This mission is optional.)

FW Pug 3A.name: Gather the fleet
FW Pug 3A.desc: Travel to <destination> and requisition two Free Worlds Dreadnoughts to join in the battle against the Pug. (But if you want to visit the Quarg or the Deep, do that first.)

FW Pug 3B.name: Escort to <planet>
FW Pug 3B.desc: Travel to <planet> with two Free Worlds Dreadnoughts that will be joining the fight against the Pug.

FW Pug 3C.name: Escort to Hephaestus
FW Pug 3C.desc: Escort the combined Free Worlds and Navy fleet to <destination>, where the Syndicate will fit all the ships with jump drives.

FW Pug 3C (Extra).name: Escort to Hephaestus
FW Pug 3C (Extra).desc: Escort the combined Free Worlds and Navy fleet to <destination>, where the Syndicate will fit all the ships with jump drives.

FW Pug 4.name: Liberate <system>
FW Pug 4.desc: Attempt to drive the Pug out of the <system> system, then land on <planet>.

FW Pug 4A.name: Defend Maker
FW Pug 4A.desc: Keep the Pug from regaining control of Maker for long enough for Freya to figure out whether it is possible to restore the hyperspace link back to the Markab system.

FW Pug 4B.name: Reflector to Hephaestus
FW Pug 4B.desc: Freya found a device that she believes is a "graviton reflector," which can somehow be set up in the <system> system to re-establish the hyperspace link between there and Delta Capricorni. Bring the transmitter to the Syndicate officials on <planet>.

FW Pug 4C.name: Return to <system>
FW Pug 4C.desc: Return to <destination>, accompanied by your new reinforcement fleet supplied by the Syndicate, and talk with Freya to decide on what your next steps should be now that you have the ability to restore the links to human space.

FW Pug 5.name: Liberate <planet>
FW Pug 5.desc: If you can drive the Pug away from <destination>, you will be able to re-establish the hyperspace link between Altair and the Sol system, and immediately bring in Navy ships as reinforcements.

FW Pug 5A.name: Reflector to <planet>
FW Pug 5A.desc: Bring this "graviton reflector" to <planet> and set it up there, in order to restore the hyperspace link between the Sol and Altair systems.

FW Pug 5B.name: Defend Altair
FW Pug 5B.desc: Freya sent you a message that the <system> system is under attack. Return there, accompanied by your new Navy reinforcements, and drive off the Pug.

FW Pug 6.name: Defeat the Pug
FW Pug 6.desc: Now that the Navy has joined you, it is time to take the battle directly to the Pug home system. Once their fleet is eliminated, land on their home world of <planet> to attempt to negotiate for peace.

FW Syndicate Extremists 1.name: Deal with the Syndicate
FW Syndicate Extremists 1.desc: Now that the Pug appear to have been driven off, it's time to get some answers from the Syndicate. Travel with Admiral Danforth back to <destination> for another meeting with the CEO of the Syndicate.

FW Syndicate Extremists 1A.name: Cloaking Device
FW Syndicate Extremists 1A.desc: Alastair Korban has agreed to give you a cloaking device that will allow you to evade missile attacks. Travel to Hephaestus, where they will install the device on your ship.

FW Syndicate Extremists 1B.name: Final Battle
FW Syndicate Extremists 1B.desc: A fleet of nuclear-armed Syndicate extremists controlled by the Alphas is occupying the <system> system. Travel there and use the cloaking device to draw their fire; the Oathkeeper fleet will be right behind you.

FW Syndicate Extremists 1C.name: Report to Parliament
FW Syndicate Extremists 1C.desc: Return to Earth to report to Parliament on the resolution of the conflicts with the Pug and with the Syndicate extremists.

FW Navy Out Of Rastaban (Bad Karma).id: FW Navy Out Of Rastaban (Bad Karma)
FW Navy Out Of Rastaban (Bad Karma).name: FW Navy Out Of Rastaban (Bad Karma)

FW Epilogue: Edward.name: Weapon Testing
FW Epilogue: Edward.desc: A test ship with new weaponry is in orbit around <planet>. Fight and disable it (but do not board or destroy it!) and then land to give Barmy Edward feedback on its performance.

FW Zug Expansion: Assisted.name: Convoy to Zug
FW Zug Expansion: Assisted.desc: Escort a convoy of freighters to <destination> for an important project. Expect pirate raids.

FW Conservatory 1.name: Take Ijs to <planet>
FW Conservatory 1.desc: Transport Mr. Eyes and the Andersons to <destination>, where he will be helping to set up a public university.

FW Conservatory 2.name: Escort to <planet>
FW Conservatory 2.desc: Escort this Free Worlds convoy to <destination>, to trade for terraforming equipment provided by Tarazed and the Syndicate.

Instruct Novice Pilot.name: Instruct Novice Pilot
Instruct Novice Pilot.desc: A novice pilot seeks instruction from an experienced captain, and requests an escort to <stopovers>. After that, return to <origin> and you will receive payment of <payment>.

Immigrant Workers.name: Immigrant Workers
Immigrant Workers.desc: A young couple wants to start a new life on <destination>, and can pay you <payment> to bring them there. They are also bringing along <cargo>.
Immigrant Workers.dest: not government; attributes core; attributes factory

Pookie, Part 1.name: Pookie
Pookie, Part 1.desc: Travel to <destination> and meet Pookie, who is staying with her aunt and may be scared of flying.

Pookie, Part 3.name: Stray Dog
Pookie, Part 3.desc: Find a home for a stray dog you picked up on <origin>. She might have been from one of the Paradise Worlds.

Smuggler's Den, Part 1.name: Refugees to <planet>
Smuggler's Den, Part 1.desc: Joe and Maria, a young couple with a newborn baby, want to escape slavery and start a new life on <destination>.

Smuggler's Den, Part 2.name: Refugees to <planet>
Smuggler's Den, Part 2.desc: Unable to find work on <origin>, Joe and Maria want to travel to <destination> to see if they can get a job there.

Expedition to Hope 1.name: Expedition to Hope
Expedition to Hope 1.desc: Transport a team of <bunks> scientists to the abandoned world of <planet>, where they will be placing <tons> of meteorological equipment. Payment will be 80,000 credits.

Expedition to Hope 2.name: Expedition to Hope
Expedition to Hope 2.desc: Transport the team of <bunks> scientists home to <destination>, to receive the second half of payment.

Transport Workers A.name: Transport Family
Transport Workers A.desc: Transport a family of <bunks>, as well as <cargo>, to <destination>, where they hope that steady work will be easier to come by. Payment is <payment>.

Transport Workers B.name: Transport Worker
Transport Workers B.desc: This young man is headed to the factories on <destination>. He says he wants to save enough money to be able to ask his "true love" to marry him.

Transport Workers C.name: Farming Family
Transport Workers C.desc: Transport this family of <bunks> farmers and <tons> of livestock, to <destination>. Payment is <payment>.

WR Star 1.name: Star Research
WR Star 1.desc: Fly through the <waypoints> system with a team of <bunks> scientists and <cargo>, then return them to <destination>.

There Might Be Riots 1.name: Transport band to <planet>
There Might Be Riots 1.desc: Give the band "There Might Be Riots" a ride to <destination>.

Shady passenger transport 2.desc: Discreetly transport two passengers to <destination>. Payment will be <payment>. If you are caught with them, you may be fined.

Shady passenger transport 3.name: Shady passenger transport
Shady passenger transport 3.desc: Discreetly transport <bunks> passengers to <destination>. Payment will be <payment>. If you are caught with them, the legal consequences may be severe.

Shady passenger transport 3 - double cro.desc: Discreetly transport <bunks> passengers to <destination>. Payment will be <payment>. If you are caught with them, the legal consequences may be severe.

Rescue Miners 1.name: Rescue Miners
Rescue Miners 1.desc: Participate in the medical evacuation of miners injured on <planet> by bringing <bunks> emergency workers and <cargo> to the planet.

Rescue Miners 2.name: Rescue Miners
Rescue Miners 2.desc: Participate in the medical evacuation of miners injured on <origin> by bringing <bunks> passengers to the medical facilities on <destination>.

Courier 2.name: Package to <planet>
Courier 2.desc: Deliver a package weighing <tons> to <destination> by <date>. Payment is <payment>.

Courier 3.desc: Deliver <tons> of legal papers to <destination> by <date>. Payment is <payment>.

Courier 4.name: Lizard to <planet>
Courier 4.desc: Deliver an exotic pet (weighing <tons>) to <destination> by <date>. Payment is <payment>.

Migrant Workers 1.name: Migrant Workers
Migrant Workers 1.desc: Bring a group of <bunks> migrant workers to <planet>. Payment is <payment>.
Migrant Workers 1.src: attributes dirt belt; attributes farming; near Zeta Aquilae

Humanitarian 1.name: Vaccine to <planet>
Humanitarian 1.desc: Bring <tons> of flu vaccines to the lawless world of <planet>. Be sure the medicine gets into the right hands.

Humanitarian 2.name: Food to <planet>
Humanitarian 2.desc: Bring <tons> of food to the lawless world of <planet>, to help alleviate a famine.

Terraforming 1.name: Terraforming Rand
Terraforming 1.desc: Bring a delegation of two people from Rand to the Academy of Planetary Sciences on Glory.

Terraforming 2.name: Terraforming Rand
Terraforming 2.desc: Return to Rand with the delegation and a student who thinks she can terraform the planet cheaply.

Terraforming 3.name: Terraforming Rand
Terraforming 3.desc: Plant a thruster on an asteroid to guide it into a collision with the northern pole of Rand.

Terraforming 4.name: Terraforming Rand
Terraforming 4.desc: Bring Amy to <destination> to collect some hardy plants that can grow in a low-light environment.

Terraforming 5.name: Terraforming Rand
Terraforming 5.desc: Bring Amy and <tons> of hardy plants that can grow in a low-light environment back to <destination>.

Terraforming 6.name: Unlawful Use of an Asteroid
Terraforming 6.desc: Travel to <destination> by <date> for questioning on your "unlawful use of an asteroid."
Terraforming 6.src: government Republic; attributes spaceport; not attributes; not system

Terraforming 7.name: Terraforming Research
Terraforming 7.desc: Bring Amy and Nolan to <destination>, where they will research and publish Amy's terraforming methods.

Terraforming 8.name: Terraforming Research
Terraforming 8.desc: Meet with Amy and Nolan on <destination> to talk about experimentally terraforming another planet.

Terraforming 9.name: Terraforming Tundra
Terraforming 9.desc: Travel to <destination> with Amy, Nolan, and four others.

Terraforming 10.name: Terraforming Tundra
Terraforming 10.desc: Bring the Republic representative overseeing the terraforming project to <destination>, where he will attempt to find an alternative solution to terraforming Tundra that does not involve an asteroid.

Terraforming 11.name: Terraforming Tundra
Terraforming 11.desc: Return to <destination> with the Republic representative.

Terraforming 12.name: Terraforming Tundra
Terraforming 12.desc: Plant a thruster on an asteroid to guide it into a collision with the dormant supervolcano on Tundra.

Terraforming Follow-up.name: Terraforming Follow-up
Terraforming Follow-up.src: government Republic; near Sol; attributes spaceport

A wolf, a goat, and a cabbage.desc: Transport a wolf, a goat, and a cabbage to <destination>. Payment will be <payment>.

Terminus exploration.name: Missing drone
Terminus exploration.desc: Travel to the <waypoints> system to see if you can find any sign of a probe drone that had been launched by a team of scientists before they were attacked by pirates and forced to flee.

Lost Boy 1.name: Rescue Tod
Lost Boy 1.desc: Travel to <destination> in search for Tod, the son of a single mother from <origin>.

Lost Boy 2.name: Rescue Tod
Lost Boy 2.desc: Locate the <npc> and board it to rescue Tod, then bring him to <destination> so that he may reunite with his mother.

Lost Boy 3.name: Bring Tod to <planet>
Lost Boy 3.desc: Now that Tod's mother knows he is safe, bring him to <destination> so that he may start his mining job to support him and his mother.

Paradise Fortune 1.name: Flee to <planet>
Paradise Fortune 1.desc: Flee from <origin> to <destination> with the girl you let on to your ship.

Paradise Fortune 2.name: Escaping Paradise
Paradise Fortune 2.desc: Escape the Paradise Worlds and travel to <destination> where Diana Howl will give over part of her family's fortune to the local government of <planet>.

Paradise Fortune 3.name: Last Hope
Paradise Fortune 3.desc: Escape from the Navy and travel to <destination> where Diana Howl hopes that the Free Worlds will help her.

Paradise Fortune 4.name: Exchange of Goods
Paradise Fortune 4.desc: Travel to <destination> and hand the backpack of credits and Diana Howl's note over to the Navy.

Northern Blockade.name: Mebsuta Disaster
Northern Blockade.desc: <destination> is under attack by pirates. Assist the Republic by delivering <cargo> to the planet as soon as possible.

Southern Blockade.name: Spaceport Defenses
Southern Blockade.desc: <stopovers> are under attack. Drop off <cargo> on these planets and return to <destination> for payment. (<payment>)

Core Blockade.name: Bad Harvest
Core Blockade.desc: The pirate world of <destination> is experiencing a famine. Warlords of the planet have threatened the Syndicate into giving them food. Deliver <cargo> to the world for <payment>.

Pirate Blockade.name: Escape to Freedom
Pirate Blockade.desc: Bring <bunks> escaped slaves to freedom on <destination>, far away from their pirate oppressor. The woman on <origin> promised that a person on <planet> would give you <payment>.

Capture Smuggler.name: Capture rogue smuggler
Capture Smuggler.desc: A smuggler absconded with his illegal cargo near <system>. The unknown person he stole it from wants it back. Recover the cargo from the <npc> and return both it and the smuggler to <origin> for <payment>.

Inheritance Redirection.name: Inheritance Redirection
Inheritance Redirection.desc: Travel to <destination> to act as heir for the late warlord Limping Pappa.

Hauler VI cargo prototype 1.name: Escort Hauler prototype to formal dinner
Hauler VI cargo prototype 1.desc: Escort the <npc> to <destination> to deliver sushi for a formal dinner.

Hauler VI cargo prototype 2.name: Escort Hauler prototype to <planet>
Hauler VI cargo prototype 2.desc: Escort the <npc> to <destination> to deliver cooked fish dishes to a streetfood festival.

Hauler VI cargo prototype 3.name: Escort Hauler prototype to waste plant
Hauler VI cargo prototype 3.desc: Escort the <npc> to <destination> to deliver charred food waste to a waste-processing plant.

Antibiotics To South.name: Antibiotics shipment to <planet>
Antibiotics To South.desc: Deliver <cargo> to <destination>. Payment is <payment>. Expect attacks from a pirate ship known as the "Australis."
Antibiotics To South.src: attributes medical; not attributes; near Sol

Pirate Duel.name: Fight at Umbral
Pirate Duel.desc: Head as quickly as you can to the Umbral system, where you will duel with a small militia vessel named the Esca. After fighting, go to <destination> to follow up.

Earth Retirement.name: Retired Family to Earth
Earth Retirement.desc: Transport two seniors to <destination>, where they plan to retire. They can only promise you <payment>.

Spacediving professionals.name: Spacediving at <planet>
Spacediving professionals.desc: Head to <destination> with <bunks> professionally equipped skydivers and drop them from the edge of space. They've agreed to pay <payment> when they land.

Spacediving professionals accident.name: Spacediving at <planet>
Spacediving professionals accident.desc: Head to <destination> with <bunks> professionally equipped skydivers and drop them from the edge of space. They've agreed to pay <payment> when they land.

Spacediving professionals disaster.name: Spacediving at <planet>
Spacediving professionals disaster.desc: Head to <destination> with <bunks> professionally equipped skydivers and drop them from the edge of space. They've agreed to pay <payment> when they land.

Spacediving amateurs.name: Spacediving at <planet>
Spacediving amateurs.desc: Head to <destination> with <bunks> poorly equipped skydivers and drop them from the edge of space. They've agreed to pay <payment> when they land.
