Human to Hai Space - No Contact.name: Human to Hai Space - No Contact

Human to Hai Space.name: Human to Hai Space
Human to Hai Space.desc: Bring a human passenger to <destination> in Hai space.
prereq: Human to Hai Space - No Contact: offered

Thrall Emigration.name: <origin> Emigration
Thrall Emigration.desc: Transport a family from <origin> to <destination>, where they hope to find better employment. They cannot pay you.

Fumbling Mugger.name: Transport to <planet>
Fumbling Mugger.desc: Bring a young woman who threatened you on <origin> to <destination>.

Laborer.name: Out of Work
Laborer.desc: A man down on his luck needs to get to <destination>. He has promised to send you payment as soon as he has it.

Saving Artifacts 1.name: Saving Artifacts
Saving Artifacts 1.desc: An Earth museum cannot care for these historical artifacts anymore. Bring them to <destination>, where they will be safe.

Saving Artifacts 2.name: Saving Artifacts
Saving Artifacts 2.desc: A pirate warlord has captured a collection of ancient statues from Winter. Go to <destination> in order to bring them to <origin>, where they will be safe.

Saving Artifacts 3.name: Duel Lokust
Saving Artifacts 3.desc: Defeat Lokust as part of a bargain to acquire the stolen statues.

Dangerous Games 1.name: Dragonriders
Dangerous Games 1.desc: A lively man named Karengo and a few passionate youths are traveling to see the dragons on <stopovers>. Take the group there, then return them to <destination> once they've finished.

Dangerous Games 2.name: Karengo's Galactic Adventures
Dangerous Games 2.desc: The adventurer Karengo and five others are traveling with you as part of his "Galactic Adventures." Bring Karengo and crew to <destination> for <payment>.

Riley.name: Visiting Home
Riley.desc: Take a woman named Riley to see her ailing father on <destination> before it's too late.
Riley.src: attributes deep; attributes urban; not planet

Wool Smuggling 1.name: Pickup at <planet>
Wool Smuggling 1.desc: Head to <destination> to pick up a shipment of 15 tons of woollen goods for delivery to Bloodsea.

Wool Smuggling 2.name: Wool to <planet>
Wool Smuggling 2.desc: Deliver <cargo> to the pirate world of <destination>. Payment will be <payment>.

Deal Change 2.name: Inheritance to <planet>
Deal Change 2.desc: Instead of bringing the inheritance to Skymoot, deliver it to <destination>. You were promised <payment> for doing so. To bypass the spaceport toll, hail <planet> and read out the code to the spaceport authority.

Escort offer (Betrayal).name: Cargo to <planet>
Escort offer (Betrayal).desc: Transport <tons> of cargo to <destination> by <date>. You will be paid <payment>. The captain of the <npc> has offered to protect you from any pirates along the way in exchange for a cut of the profits.

Quicksilver Mixup 0.name: Package to Silver
Quicksilver Mixup 0.desc: Deliver a package to <planet> by <date>. Payment is <payment>.

Quicksilver Mixup 1.name: Redirect Package to <planet>
Quicksilver Mixup 1.desc: Apparently the package labeled for <origin> was actually intended for <planet>. You'll have missed the deadline, so you probably won't be paid the <payment> offered.

Quicksilver Mixup 2.name: Misposted Mail Delivery
Quicksilver Mixup 2.desc: Deliver <tons> of misposted mail from <origin> to <planet> by <date> and then come back with the return shipment. You will be paid <payment> after you return from <planet>.

Quicksilver Mixup 3.name: Misposted Mail Delivery
Quicksilver Mixup 3.desc: Return to <planet> with <cargo>. You will be paid <payment>.

Argosy Hijacking.name: Stop Ship Hijacking
Argosy Hijacking.desc: The <npc> was hijacked on <origin>; disable it and return to <origin>. Do not board, capture, or destroy it; Syndicated Security will deal with the hijackers in space after you have disabled it.

Ka'het: Patir Mystery 9.name: Explore the neighborhood

Ka'het: Patir Mystery 10.name: Gather data

Ka'het: Patir Mystery 11.name: Gather more data

Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1A.name: The <system> station

Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.1B.name: Return to <system>

Ka'het: Patir Mystery 12.2A.name: Satellite deployment

Wanderer Kor Efreti: Equipment.desc: Deliver <cargo> to the Kor Efreti on <destination>. Payment is <payment>.

Wanderer Kor Efreti: Cargo [0].name: Delivery to <planet>
Wanderer Kor Efreti: Cargo [0].desc: Deliver <cargo> to the Kor Efreti on <destination>. Payment is <payment>.

Wanderer Kor Efreti: Cargo [1].name: Delivery to <planet>
Wanderer Kor Efreti: Cargo [1].desc: Deliver <cargo> to the Kor Efreti on <destination>. Payment is <payment>.

Wanderers to Kor Efreti.name: Investigating Kor Efreti worlds
Wanderers to Kor Efreti.desc: Take this mix of <bunks> Wanderer scientists, botanists, and terraforming experts to the Kor Efret world of <stopovers> and back. Payment is <payment>.

Wanderers: Mereti: The Plant 1.name: Plant to <planet>
Wanderers: Mereti: The Plant 1.desc: This plant seems to be of some significance to the Mereti. Bring the plant and two Wanderer 'mentors' to <destination> so that the Wanderers can try to work out how to make it grow.

Wanderers: Mereti: The Plant 2.name: A Home for the Plant
Wanderers: Mereti: The Plant 2.desc: Bring Keti Va'ika to the Korath planets she marked to determine whether any of them are a suitable home for the plant from the Mereti.

Wanderers: Mereti: The Plant 3.name: A Home for the Plant
Wanderers: Mereti: The Plant 3.desc: Bring Keti Va'ika to the Korath planets she marked to determine whether any of them are a suitable home for the plant from the Mereti.

Wanderers: Mereti: The Plant 4.name: Return to <planet>
Wanderers: Mereti: The Plant 4.desc: Bring Va'ika back to <destination> in order to collect the Mereti plant and bring it to <origin>.

Wanderers: Mereti: The Plant 5.name: Plant to <planet>
Wanderers: Mereti: The Plant 5.desc: Escort the Wanderer ship, carrying the plant and a team of Wanderers ready to help it grow, to <destination>.

Wanderers: Surveying 1.name: Wanderer Surveying
Wanderers: Surveying 1.desc: The Wanderers asked you to survey several of the nearby planets in Korath space, and to bring the data back to them on <planet> when you are done.

Wanderers: Surveying 2.name: Wanderer Surveying
Wanderers: Surveying 2.desc: The Wanderers have asked you to survey some more worlds, which are deep in the territory of the Kor Mereti drones, and to bring the measurements back to them on <planet>.

Wanderers: Nova Remnants.name: Nova Remnants
Wanderers: Nova Remnants.desc: A Wanderer cosmologist named Erukt Isi'ithi asked you to visit several nearby stars that seem to be supernova remnants, and to make measurements on them.

Wanderers: Mereti Controller.name: Kor Mereti Controller
Wanderers: Mereti Controller.desc: Board one of the Kor Mereti drones, find whatever component is controlling its actions, and bring that component back to the Wanderers on <planet>.

Wanderers: Sestor Controller.name: Kor Sestor Controller
Wanderers: Sestor Controller.desc: Board one of the Kor Sestor drones, find whatever component is controlling its actions, and bring that component back to the Wanderers on <planet>.

Wanderers: First Mereti Attack.name: Defend <planet>
Wanderers: First Mereti Attack.desc: The Wanderer base on <planet> is under attack by Kor Mereti drones. Help the Wanderers to drive them off, then return to the planet.

Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret.name: Bring Rek to <planet>
Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret.desc: Bring Rek, who has survived the Molt and taken on a new form, to try to communicate with the Kor Efret on <destination>.

Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 1.name: Quarg Assistance
Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 1.desc: Ektasi Rek suggested that you should visit the Quarg and ask if they can help defend the Wanderers from Kor Mereti attacks.
prereq: Wanderers: Rek To Kor Efret: done

Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 2.name: Quarg Assistance
Wanderers: Quarg Assistance 2.desc: Escort a Quarg fleet that has agreed to help protect the Wanderers back to <destination>.

Wanderers: Pug Assistance 1.name: Pug Assistance
Wanderers: Pug Assistance 1.desc: The Wanderers are thankful for the protection of the Quarg, but hope that the Pug on <planet> will be willing to send warships to protect them as well.

Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2.name: Return to <planet>
Wanderers: Pug Assistance 2.desc: Return to <planet> to tell the Wanderers there that the Pug refuse to send any ships through the Eye to help defend them.

Wanderers: Mereti Observation.name: Mereti Observation
Wanderers: Mereti Observation.desc: Observe the Kor Mereti in Mesuket for long enough for the Wanderer equipment to collect data on their communications. Then return to <planet>.

Wanderers: Kor Efret 1.name: Visit <planet>
Wanderers: Kor Efret 1.desc: Visit Ektasi Rek and the Korath on <planet>, and see if they have information that could help in neutralizing the Kor Mereti automata.

Wanderers: Kor Efret 2.name: Korath Engineers
Wanderers: Kor Efret 2.desc: The Korath on <origin> referred you to a team of engineers on <planet> who have been working to try to eliminate the automata.

Wanderers: Kor Efret 3.name: Defend <planet>
Wanderers: Kor Efret 3.desc: Defend this Kor Efret world from a Kor Mereti raid. Hopefully if you hold out long enough, more reinforcements will arrive.

Wanderers: Kor Efret 4.name: Return to <planet>
Wanderers: Kor Efret 4.desc: Transport Ektasi Rek back to <planet>, where she will continue her work to understand the Korath language and culture.

Wanderers: Kor Efret 5.name: Return to <planet>
Wanderers: Kor Efret 5.desc: Return to <planet> and report to Sobari Tele'ek that the Korath do not think the Mereti drone network can be compromised.

Wanderers: Kor Mereti Hacking.name: Kor Mereti Hacking
Wanderers: Kor Mereti Hacking.desc: Test a device that the Wanderers think may be able to gain access to the Kor Mereti network and disrupt it.

Wanderers: Mind 1.name: Travel to <planet>
Wanderers: Mind 1.desc: Travel to the Wanderer artificial intelligence lab on <planet>, where they will give you one of the "artificial minds" they have constructed.

Wanderers: Mind 2.name: Return to <planet>
Wanderers: Mind 2.desc: Return to <planet> with a Wanderer named Meto Pa'aret and an "artificial mind" that he constructed.

Wanderers: Mind 3.name: Fetch Escorts
Wanderers: Mind 3.desc: When you are ready, visit <planet> to rendezvous with the fleet that will be accompanying you in your attempt to link a Wanderer artificial Mind to the Kor Mereti network.

Wanderers: Mind 4.name: Return to <planet>
Wanderers: Mind 4.desc: Escort the Wanderer fleet back to <planet>, where you will prepare to infiltrate the Kor Mereti station.

Wanderers: Mind 5.name: Install the Mind
Wanderers: Mind 5.desc: A Wanderer fleet will accompany you to the Chimitarp system, to install the Mind on the Korath station there.

Wanderers: Mind 6.name: Defend the Mind
Wanderers: Mind 6.desc: Fight off any of the Kor Mereti drones that are still attacking the Wanderers. Try not to anger the ones that seem to have switched sides.

Wanderers: Kor Mereti Quarg Attitude Pat.id: Wanderers: Kor Mereti Quarg Attitude Patch
Wanderers: Kor Mereti Quarg Attitude Pat.name: Wanderers: Kor Mereti Quarg Attitude Patch

Wanderers: Mind 7.name: Investigate <planet>
Wanderers: Mind 7.desc: Visit <destination> and figure out what the Kor Mereti are doing there, now that they are apparently no longer hostile.

Wanderers: Mind 8.name: Investigate <origin>
Wanderers: Mind 8.desc: Report the new behavior of the Kor Mereti drones to the Wanderers.

Wanderers: Mentors 1.name: Visit <planet>
Wanderers: Mentors 1.desc: Travel to <planet> to meet up with a team of Wanderer professors and scientists who are eager to work with the Kor Mereti drones.

Wanderers: Mentors 2.name: Wanderers to <planet>
Wanderers: Mentors 2.desc: Escort this Wanderer transport safely to <planet>, where the scientists and professors on board will begin teaching and mentoring the Kor Mereti.

Wanderers: Mentors 3.name: Return to <planet>
Wanderers: Mentors 3.desc: Return to <planet> to see what the Wanderer leaders have planned next.

Wanderers: Tour 1.name: Kor Efret Diplomacy
Wanderers: Tour 1.desc: Visit Ektasi Rek on <planet> and see if the Kor Efret would like to come to <origin> for a diplomatic visit.

Wanderers: Tour 2.name: Kor Efret Diplomacy
Wanderers: Tour 2.desc: Escort a Kor Efret ship back to <planet> for a diplomatic visit.

Wanderers: Tour 3.name: Kor Efret Tour
Wanderers: Tour 3.desc: Escort a Kor Efret ship to <planet>, to give them a taste of what Wanderer terraforming of a world can achieve.

Wanderers: Tour 4.name: Kor Efret Tour
Wanderers: Tour 4.desc: Escort a Kor Efret ship to <planet>, to show them how Wanderer farming worlds are run.

Wanderers: Tour 5.name: Kor Efret Tour
Wanderers: Tour 5.desc: Escort a Kor Efret ship to <planet>, where the Wanderers are battling the Unfettered.

Wanderers: Tour 6.name: Kor Efret Tour
Wanderers: Tour 6.desc: Escort the Kor Efret ship back through the Eye to <planet>.

Wanderers: Tour 7.name: Return to <planet>
Wanderers: Tour 7.desc: Return to <planet> with Rek's report from the Kor Efret diplomatic tour.

Wanderers: Sestor Scanning.name: Scan Sestor Planets
Wanderers: Sestor Scanning.desc: Scan all the habitable planets in Sestor space to attempt to find where the control center for the automata is located.

Wanderers: Sestor Attack.name: Defend <planet>
Wanderers: Sestor Attack.desc: <planet> is under attack by a Kor Sestor fleet. Drive them off, then return to the planet to figure out what to do next.

Wanderers: Sestor Search.name: Find the Sestor fleet
Wanderers: Sestor Search.desc: A large Kor Sestor fleet passed through the wormhole to Wanderer space. Figure out where they went and what they are doing there.

Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Hint.name: Warn Admiral Danforth
Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Hint.desc: Meet with Admiral Danforth on <planet> as soon as possible, to warn him of the possible threat from the Kor Sestor fleet.
prereq: Wanderers: Sestor Search: Wanderer Hint: offered

Wanderers: Sestor Search: Wanderer Hint.name: Warn Admiral Danforth
Wanderers: Sestor Search: Wanderer Hint.desc: Meet with Admiral Danforth on <planet> as soon as possible, to warn him of the possible threat from the Kor Sestor fleet.
prereq: Wanderers: Sestor Search: Human Hint: offered

Wanderers: Sestor: Farpoint Attack 1.name: Defend Farpoint
Wanderers: Sestor: Farpoint Attack 1.desc: Farpoint is under attack by a Kor Sestor fleet. Drive them off, then return to the planet to speak with Admiral Danforth.

Wanderers: Sestor: Quarg Help 1.name: Ask the Quarg for help
Wanderers: Sestor: Quarg Help 1.desc: Admiral Danforth asked you to visit <planet> and ask the Quarg if they can provide any ships to help you fight off the Kor Sestor fleet (now presumably under Alpha control).

Wanderers: Sestor: Quarg Help 2.name: Return to <planet>
Wanderers: Sestor: Quarg Help 2.desc: Return to <planet> with this small fleet of Quarg ships.

Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 1.name: Deliver device to Zenith
Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 1.desc: Admiral Danforth asked you to drop this device (presumably a bomb) above the Alpha base on <destination>.

Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 2.name: Return to <planet>
Wanderers: Sestor: Bomb Zenith 2.desc: You have destroyed the Alpha base on Zenith. Return to Farpoint and find out if your intervention allowed Danforth to gain the upper hand against the Kor Sestor fleet.

Wanderers: Sestor: Kill Southern Remnant.name: Destroy Kor Sestor drones
Wanderers: Sestor: Kill Southern Remnant.desc: When you destroyed the Alpha base, the Kor Sestor drones began acting independently. They are now attacking human space. Help the Navy destroy the drones, then return to <planet>.

Wanderers: Sestor: Remnant Visit.name: Wanderers: Sestor: Remnant Visit
prereq: Wanderers: Sestor: Kill Southern Remnant: active

Wanderers: Sestor: Drones in Alnilam Way.id: Wanderers: Sestor: Drones in Alnilam Waypoint
Wanderers: Sestor: Drones in Alnilam Way.name: Drones in Alnilam
Wanderers: Sestor: Drones in Alnilam Way.desc: Eliminate the remaining Kor Sestor fleet in the Alnilam system.

Wanderers: Sestor: Return to Wanderers.name: Return to <planet>
Wanderers: Sestor: Return to Wanderers.desc: The Kor Sestor drones in human space have been eliminated. Return to <planet> in Wanderer space to find out what is happening there.

Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 1.name: Destroy remaining drones
Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 1.desc: Rather than bombing Zenith, destroy any Kor Sestor drones that are left over in the Alnilam system, then report back to Admiral Danforth on Farpoint.

Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 2.name: Attack Alpha base
Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 2.desc: Travel to the <system> system with these Oathkeeper Cruisers to eliminate the Alpha base on <planet>.

Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 3.name: Return to <planet>
Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Alnilam 3.desc: Escort the Oathkeeper Cruisers back to <destination>.

Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Return to Wandere.id: Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Return to Wanderers
Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Return to Wandere.name: Return to <planet>
Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Return to Wandere.desc: The Kor Sestor drones in human space have been eliminated. Return to <planet> in Wanderer space to find out what is happening there.

Wanderers: Sestor: Scan Drones.name: Scan remaining drones
Wanderers: Sestor: Scan Drones.desc: Scan the remaining Kor Sestor drones in a few of their systems, to collect data for the Wanderers to use to determine how quickly they are still being produced.
prereq: Wanderers: Sestor Alt: Return to Wanderers: done
Wanderers: Sestor: Return to Wanderers: done

Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 1.name: Pick up Rek
Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 1.desc: Pick up Rek on <planet>. She will be helping you to attempt to open diplomatic negotiations with the Korath exiles.

Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 2.name: Contact the exiles
Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 2.desc: Enter the territory of the Korath exiles. Do not fire on them. Instead, with Rek's help, try to find a way to speak with them or a place where they will meet with you.

Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 3.name: Diplomacy with the exiles
Wanderers: Sestor: Exiles 3.desc: Escort these three Korath exile world-ships to <planet> for a diplomatic meeting with the Wanderers.

Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 1.name: Shut down the factory
Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 1.desc: Escort these Korath ships to <planet>, where they will shut down the remaining Kor Sestor factories.

Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 2.name: Defend <planet>
Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 2.desc: Drive off the Kor Sestor drones and keep them from interfering with the Korath exiles who are shutting down their factories.

Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 3.name: Return to <planet>
Wanderers: Sestor: Factory 3.desc: Return to <planet> and report to the Wanderers that the exiles have shut down the Kor Sestor factory (and possibly stolen the equipment in the process).

Wanderers: Sestor: Final: Patched.name: Investigate the exiles
Wanderers: Sestor: Final: Patched.desc: Visit the Korath exile territory to look for any signs that they plan to start constructing war drones of their own.

First Contact: Wanderer.name: Hai Interpreter?
First Contact: Wanderer.desc: The aliens north of Hai space seem to speak the Hai language. If you can find one of the Hai who is willing to interpret, perhaps you can communicate with them.

Wanderers: Hai Diplomat.name: Hai Diplomat
Wanderers: Hai Diplomat.desc: Travel to Hai-home to pick up a diplomat who can help you communicate with the Wanderers.

Wanderers: Diplomacy.name: Wanderer Diplomacy
Wanderers: Diplomacy.desc: Travel to the Wanderer homeworld with a Hai ambassador who can help communicate with them.

Wanderers: Translation Machine.name: Translation Machine
Wanderers: Translation Machine.desc: Sayari, the Hai ambassador, suggested that you visit <destination>, where Hai technologists are working on translation machines.

Human Cultural Archives.name: Human Cultural Archives
Human Cultural Archives.desc: Eruk, the Hai technologist on <origin>, has agreed to give you a translation machine if you can somehow get him a copy of the human cultural data from <destination>.

Cultural Data to Greenwater.name: Cultural Data to Greenwater
Cultural Data to Greenwater.desc: Bring a copy of the human cultural archives to <destination> in exchange for a translation machine.

Visit Wanderers Again.name: Visit Wanderers Again
Visit Wanderers Again.desc: Return to the Wanderer homeworld of <destination> with a device that will allow you to converse with them more freely.

Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint.name: Wanderer supplies to <planet>
Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint.desc: Transport <cargo> to <destination>, where repairs are needed from Unfettered attacks.

Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok.name: Defend <planet>
Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok.desc: Defend <planet> from an Unfettered attack by driving off or destroying the Hai ships.
prereq: Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint: active
Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint: done

Wanderers: Defended Vara Ke'sok.name: Report to <planet>
Wanderers: Defended Vara Ke'sok.desc: Report to the Wanderer elders on <destination> that the Unfettered attacks are intensifying and moving farther in from the front.

Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1.name: Unfettered Diplomacy
Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1.desc: Pick up a shipment of food on the Wanderer planet <destination>, to be delivered to the Unfettered as a peace offering.

Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1A.name: Unfettered Diplomacy
Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1A.desc: Escort a freighter carrying "tribute" to the Unfettered world of <destination>. You may need to bribe the Unfettered to keep them from attacking you.

Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1B.name: Unfettered Diplomacy
Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1B.desc: Escort this Wanderer freighter safely back to <destination>.

Wanderers: Truce Check.name: Check with Iktat Rek?
Wanderers: Truce Check.desc: Meet up with Iktat Rek on <planet> to see if there is anything more you can do to help the Wanderers now that they have established a ceasefire with the Unfettered.

Wanderers: Jump Drive Source.name: Jump drive source?
Wanderers: Jump Drive Source.desc: Iktat Rek asked you to acquire a spare jump drive and sell it to the Unfettered in exchange for information on where they are getting jump drives from. Then, return to <destination>.

Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A.name: Alpha Surveillance
Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A.desc: Drop off surveillance micro-satellites in the three Unfettered home systems, then stop by <destination> to see if the Hai government knows anything about an Alpha enclave nearby.

Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance B.name: Alpha Surveillance
Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance B.desc: Travel through the three Unfettered systems to retrieve the surveillance recordings, then report back to Iktat Rek on <destination>.

Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C.name: Alpha Surveillance
Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C.desc: The Wanderers have no technology for tracking a ship that is using a jump drive, but Iktat Rek thinks the Quarg might be able to and suggested visiting them on <destination>.

Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Naughty.name: Alpha Surveillance
Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Naughty.desc: The Wanderers have no technology for tracking a ship that is using a jump drive, but Iktat Rek thinks the Quarg might be able to and suggested visiting them on <destination>.

Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D.name: Find the Alphas
Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D.desc: With the help of Elias Hanover and his tracker device, locate the Alpha Base and then return to the Quarg ringworld of <planet>.

Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance E.name: Visit Danforth
Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance E.desc: Visit Admiral Danforth on <planet> and see if he is able to supply you with an attack force to locate and destroy the Alpha base.

Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance F.name: Invade Avalon
Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance F.desc: Escort Admiral Danforth's Navy <npc model> to <destination> and land on the planet with them. They will attempt to locate and eliminate the Alpha base.

Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G.name: Return to <planet>
Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G.desc: Escort Admiral Danforth's ship safely back to <destination>.

Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H.name: Meet up with Danforth
Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H.desc: Meet Admiral Danforth in the spaceport on <origin>, and talk about what to do next about the Alphas.

Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance I.name: Return Elias to <planet>
Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance I.desc: Bring Elias Hanover back to <destination>, where he will hopefully be safe from Alpha retaliation for driving them out of their base on Avalon.

Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance J.name: Return to Iktat Rek on <planet>
Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance J.desc: Check in with Iktat Rek on <planet> in the <system> system, now that the Alpha base has been eliminated.

Wanderers Invaded 0.name: Unfettered Invasion
Wanderers Invaded 0.desc: Travel to <destination> to ask Iktat Rek if you can assist the Wanderers against the Unfettered invasion.

Wanderers Invaded 1.name: Evacuate <planet>
Wanderers Invaded 1.desc: Escort a fleet of freighters, refitted for carrying refugees, to <destination>.

Wanderers Invaded 1B.name: Evacuate <origin>
Wanderers Invaded 1B.desc: Escort a fleet of freighters, refitted for carrying refugees, to <destination>.

Wanderers Invaded 2.name: Defend <planet>
Wanderers Invaded 2.desc: Drive off the Unfettered fleet attacking <system> to buy the Wanderers more time, then land on <planet>.

Wanderers Invaded 3.name: Evacuate <origin>
Wanderers Invaded 3.desc: Escort another fleet of Wanderer refugee transports to <destination>.

Wanderers Invaded 3B.name: Wanderer Meeting
Wanderers Invaded 3B.desc: Join the Wanderer leaders on <planet> for a meeting to discuss strategy against the Unfettered.

Wanderers Invaded 3C.name: Waiting for the Eye
Wanderers Invaded 3C.desc: Figure out what controls the wormhole that the Wanderers call the "Eye," and try to find information on when it will open and where.

Wanderers Hai Assistance 1.name: Hai Assistance
Wanderers Hai Assistance 1.desc: Travel to <planet> with Ambassador Sayari and see if she can convince the Hai to help restrain the Unfettered from attacking the Wanderers.

Wanderers Hai Assistance 2.name: Unfettered Negotiations
Wanderers Hai Assistance 2.desc: Travel to the Unfettered military planet <destination>, and see if they will agree to give the Wanderers time to evacuate their worlds near the front.

Wanderers Hai Assistance 3.name: Return to <planet>
Wanderers Hai Assistance 3.desc: Return with Sayari to <destination>, and tell Iktat Rek that you had some success in convincing the Hai to interfere with the Unfettered.

Wanderers Solifuge Recon 1.name: Report to <planet>
Wanderers Solifuge Recon 1.desc: Report to the Wanderer military base on <destination>, and see if there is anything you can help them with.

Wanderers Solifuge Recon 2.name: New Unfettered ships
Wanderers Solifuge Recon 2.desc: Unfettered ships of an unknown design have been spotted in the Prakacha'a system. Destroy them, then return to <destination>.

Wanderers Solifuge Recon 3.name: New Unfettered ships
Wanderers Solifuge Recon 3.desc: Ambassador Sayari is concerned that the development of the Solifuge could become a problem for the Hai and has asked that you deliver a message to the council of elders on <destination>.

Wanderers Solifuge Recon 4.name: Return to <planet>
Wanderers Solifuge Recon 4.desc: Return to <destination>, where an evacuation fleet is waiting to be escorted.

Wanderers Evacuation 1.name: Evacuate <planet>
Wanderers Evacuation 1.desc: Escort another fleet of Wanderer refugee transports to <destination>.

Wanderers Evacuation 1B.name: Refugees to <planet>
Wanderers Evacuation 1B.desc: Escort these transports carrying Wanderer refugees to their home world of <destination>, where they will hopefully be safe.

Wanderers Defend Sich'ka'ara.name: Defend <planet>
Wanderers Defend Sich'ka'ara.desc: Drive off the Unfettered fleet attacking <system>, then land on <planet>.

Wanderers Rescue 1.name: Wanderer Rescue
Wanderers Rescue 1.desc: Some Wanderer warriors were left behind on <planet> when the Unfettered captured the planet. Land on the planet with two Wanderer warships, and rescue them.

Wanderers Rescue 1B.name: Wanderer Rescue
Wanderers Rescue 1B.desc: Escort these two Wanderer warships, carrying rescued warriors from <origin>, safely back to <destination>.

Wanderers Rescue 1C.name: Visit Iktat Rek
Wanderers Rescue 1C.desc: Return to <destination>, where Iktat Rek's condition has continued to deteriorate.

Wanderers Rek 0.name: Bring Rek to <planet>
Wanderers Rek 0.desc: Bring Iktat Rek to <destination>, where there is an advanced medical facility that can hopefully treat him.

Wanderers Rek 1.name: Visit Sko'karak
Wanderers Rek 1.desc: Rek asked you to visit the Sko'karak system, then return to <planet> and tell him what you found there.

Wanderers Rek 2.name: Visit Sko'karak again
Wanderers Rek 2.desc: Rek asked you to visit the Sko'karak system again, and see if anything has changed there. Then, return to <destination>.

Wanderers Rek 3.name: Visit Sko'karak
Wanderers Rek 3.desc: Visit the Sko'karak system for a third time, and see if anything has changed there. Then, return to <planet> to report to Rek.

Wanderers Ap'arak 1.name: Help defend <planet>
Wanderers Ap'arak 1.desc: Return to <destination>, where the Wanderers have chosen to take their stand against the Unfettered incursion.

Wanderers Ap'arak 2.name: Help defend <planet>
Wanderers Ap'arak 2.desc: Defend <planet> from an Unfettered invasion fleet, then land back on the planet.

Wanderers Ap'arak 3.name: Report to <planet>
Wanderers Ap'arak 3.desc: Return to the Wanderer capital on <destination>.
